raw: brought us to that precipice
translation: 悬崖边缘
note: precipice＝悬崖，比喻灾难临界点；同根词 precipitous（陡峭的）。

raw: to discuss how quants fared
translation: 表现如何；过得怎样
note: fare 作动词＝（在某境遇中）表现；常见义为名词「车费」。

raw: lent money without proper diligence
translation: 尽职调查；审慎核查
note: diligence 此处是 due diligence 的简说；常见义「勤奋」。

raw: ignored and/or exacerbated the situation
translation: 加剧；恶化
note: exacerbate＝使坏局面更糟；形近词 exaggerate（夸大）。

raw: Dodgy accounting practices
translation: 不靠谱的；有猫腻的
note: dodgy（英式口语）＝可疑、耍滑头的；同根 dodge（闪躲）。

raw: skewed compensation practices
translation: 扭曲的；畸形的
note: skew 本义使歪斜；统计学中 skewness＝偏度。

raw: irresponsible rumormongering on the Internet
translation: 散布谣言
note: -monger 后缀＝贩卖…的人（如 warmonger 战争贩子）；rumor-mongering＝造谣传谣。

raw: divert attention from the real causes and culprits
translation: 罪魁祸首
note: culprit＝元凶、罪犯；divert attention from＝转移对…的注意力。

raw: loudly lobbying for banning short sales
translation: 游说
note: lobby 作动词＝向立法/监管者施压争取；名词义「大堂」。

raw: It was caused by irresponsible banks that lent money without proper diligence to unqualified consumers, who acted with total disregard to their own financial realities; enabled by ratings agencies that had lost all sense of independence and objectivity—though, perhaps more accurately, they only made a breathtakingly clear example of their conflicted interests; and regulators, who ignored and/or exacerbated the situation.
translation: 危机由不负责任的银行造成——它们不做尽职调查就放贷给完全无视自身财务状况的不合格消费者；又有丧失独立性与客观性（更准确地说，只是把自身利益冲突暴露得触目惊心）的评级机构推波助澜；还有对局面视而不见甚至火上浇油的监管者。
note: caused by…; enabled by…; and regulators 三个并列施动者以分号分隔；that/who 定语从句层层嵌套；破折号内为作者的修正性插入；conflicted interests＝利益冲突。

raw: written by our interloping friend Michael Lewis
translation: 闯入（别人领域）的；不请自来的
note: interlope＝闯进他人地盘插一脚；此处调侃《大空头》原作者 Michael Lewis 屡屡「闯入」金融题材。

raw: despite the attempted smokescreen
translation: 烟幕弹；障眼法
note: smokescreen 原指军事烟幕，引申为转移视线的幌子。

raw: toxic balance sheets
translation: 有毒资产负债表
note: toxic assets＝价值暴跌、无人接盘的问题资产；toxic 为金融引申义。

raw: uncounted and untold billions in losses
translation: 数不清的
note: untold 此处＝多得说不清的；另义「未被讲述的」。

raw: enough to stem the pace of the collapse
translation: 遏制；止住
note: stem 此处为及物动词「堵住、遏制」；注意与 stem from（源于）区分。

raw: the most benign monetary policy in American history
translation: 宽松温和的
note: benign 本句指货币政策极度宽松；医学义「良性的」，常见义「和善的」。

raw: one hell of a very real mess
translation: 不折不扣的；十足的
note: one hell of a＝口语强调「非常了不得的」，可褒可贬。

raw: those railing against hedge funds and short sellers
translation: 猛烈抨击
note: rail against＝大声疾呼地谴责；与「铁轨」rail 同形异义。

raw: one week after the ban was lifted
translation: 解除（禁令）
note: lift 此处＝撤销（禁令、封锁）；常见义「举起」。

raw: when it burst, unleashed all this havoc
translation: 释放出（浩劫）
note: unleash＝解开狗链放出，引申为释放破坏力；havoc＝大破坏。

raw: precipitated anything associated with the real economic crisis
translation: 促发；触发
note: precipitate 作动词＝使提前/突然发生；化学义「沉淀」；同根 precipice（悬崖）、precipitous（陡然的）。

raw: mispricings between various tranches of a company's capital structure
translation: （资本结构的）分层；份额
note: tranche（法语「切片」）＝同一发行中按风险与优先级切分的层级。

raw: buying massively distressed assets
translation: 不良的；陷入困境的（资产）
note: distressed assets/debt＝发行方濒临违约、价格深度折让的资产。

raw: But inferring that they were involved in the creation of a crisis is like saying the world is round because California grows good avocados.
translation: 但据此推断他们参与制造了危机，就好比说「因为加州盛产好牛油果，所以地球是圆的」。
note: 动名词短语 inferring that…作主语；is like saying…类比结构，讽刺前后毫无因果关联。

raw: far more instrumental in the crisis of 2008
translation: 起重要作用的
note: instrumental 本句义「起关键作用的」；另义「乐器的；工具的」。

raw: buying fancy houses with no down payments
translation: 首付
note: down payment＝分期购房的首付款；no down payments＝零首付。

raw: no proof of financial wherewithal
translation: 财力；所需资金
note: wherewithal（不可数）＝做某事所需的钱财资源，常与 the 连用。

raw: an abuse of the concept of diversification
translation: 分散化
note: diversification＝通过分散持仓降低单一风险；此处指其被滥用于为劣质贷款打包背书。

raw: it was infamously assumed
translation: 臭名昭著地
note: infamous（读音 /ˈɪnfəməs/）＝因坏事出名，并非 famous 的简单否定。

raw: no systemic risk
translation: 系统性风险
note: systemic＝波及整个体系的；辨析 systematic（系统化、有条理的）。

raw: But making a huge number of equally bad loans was probably a completely fine idea because, it was infamously assumed, not all those loans would go bad all at once.
translation: 但（他们认为）发放海量同样糟糕的贷款大概完全没问题，因为——这一假设后来臭名昭著——这些贷款不会全部同时变成坏账。
note: making…loans 动名词作主语；it was infamously assumed 为插入语；go bad＝变质、变坏账；all at once＝同时。

raw: copulas, Lévy models, saddlepoint approximations
translation: Copula（连接函数）等定价数学工具
note: copula 用于刻画多资产违约相关性，是CDO定价的核心模型；Lévy 模型、鞍点近似同为信用衍生品定价技术。

raw: nothing to do with their promulgation throughout the investment community
translation: 推广；传播
note: promulgate＝正式颁布/广泛传播；此处指结构化产品在投资界的扩散。

raw: the financial engineering that drives the creation of structured products
translation: 金融工程
note: 指设计与定价衍生品、结构化证券的学科；作者强调它与量化交易几乎无交集。

raw: Quant traders do not originate securities
translation: 创设；发起（证券）
note: originate 此处为信贷术语「发起（贷款/证券）」；常见义「起源于」。

raw: follow the path of least resistance
translation: 走阻力最小的路
note: 物理学比喻：人如水流趋易避难；常用于描述制度激励下的行为规律。

raw: awarded free (to them) do-overs
translation: 免费重来的机会
note: do-over（美式口语）＝推倒重来的机会；(to them) 插入强调代价由别人承担。

raw: Selah
translation: （希伯来语）到此打住、细细品味
note: 《圣经·诗篇》段落结尾的礼仪性标记词，作者借用表示「此节说完，请自行体会」。

raw: 2008 was a banner year
translation: 丰收的；大获成功的（年份）
note: banner 作形容词＝极出色的；本义「横幅」。

raw: even if −10 percent was the norm
translation: 常态；普遍水平
note: norm 此处＝普遍水准；另义「规范」（social norms）。

raw: Many large, storied money market funds have gone bust
translation: 声名显赫的；富有传奇的
note: storied＝有辉煌历史的（与 story 同根，非「楼层」义）；go bust（口语）＝破产倒闭。

raw: To my way of thinking
translation: 依我看
note: ＝in my opinion 的书面变体。

raw: it is categorically untrue
translation: 断然地；完全地
note: categorically＝斩钉截铁地（否认/声明）；源自逻辑学「范畴」。

raw: the last two severe market dislocations
translation: 市场失灵；价格错位
note: dislocation 本句指市场剧烈失序；医学义「脱臼」。

raw: immune from losses or unaffected by market turmoil
translation: 不受（亏损）影响的
note: immune 本句义「免受…的」；医学义「免疫的」；turmoil＝动荡。

raw: an immense double standard applied to quants
translation: 双重标准
note: double standard＝对不同对象宽严不一的评判尺度。

raw: in order for the event to be of importance to a quant, the regime change must be both large and without much warning
translation: 要使（事件对量化真正构成影响）
note: in order for A to do＝不定式带逻辑主语A；be of importance＝be important 的名词化表达；regime change＝市场状态切换。

raw: faced a liquidity crisis
translation: 流动性危机
note: 指市场深度骤降、持仓卖不出去，只能大幅折价成交的局面。

raw: at least three separate episodes of substantial pain
translation: （一轮）发作；一波
note: episode 本句指一段疼痛期；常见义「（剧集的）一集」。

raw: The trend favoring growth over value from May 2007 to January 2008 is easily seen to be sharper than that which favored value before May 2007.
translation: 2007年5月至2008年1月成长股跑赢价值股的趋势，明显比2007年5月之前价值股占优的趋势更为陡峭。
note: 主语 trend 带现在分词后置定语 favoring growth over value；that which favored value 中 that 替代前述 trend；is easily seen to be 为「被动+不定式」结构。

raw: two other periods catch the eye
translation: 引人注目
note: catch the eye＝抓住眼球；以引人注意的事物作主语。

raw: becomes inverted at such times
translation: 颠倒的；反转的
note: invert＝上下/内外颠倒；此处指市场原有行为规律整个反转。

raw: able to successfully navigate these periods
translation: 安然渡过；应对
note: navigate 本句义「设法穿越（困难时期）」；常见义「导航」。

raw: sit on the sidelines during normal times
translation: 在场边观望
note: sideline＝球场边线；on the sidelines＝不下场参与。

raw: the resumption of such longer-term trends
translation: 恢复；重新开始
note: resume 的名词形式；辨析 résumé（简历）。

raw: These counter-trend traders
translation: 逆势（策略）交易者
note: 专做长期趋势短暂反转行情的策略，常在趋势策略的受难期获利。

raw: known as breakout trading
translation: 突破交易
note: 平时空仓观望、待价格突破区间或出现大错位才入场的策略。

raw: in the wake of the disastrous performance
translation: 紧随…之后；在…之后
note: in the wake of＝船尾航迹的比喻，指紧接某事件之后。

raw: it is a patently false claim
translation: 明显地；显而易见地
note: patently＝一眼可见地（多与 false/obvious/absurd 连用）；与专利 patent 同形。

raw: with both vehemence and certainty
translation: 激烈；斩钉截铁
note: vehemence＝言辞的激烈强度；形容词 vehement。

raw: The number of degrees of freedom
translation: 自由度
note: 统计与建模术语：可独立选择的参数或决策维度的个数。

raw: ostensibly looking for the same types of anomalies
translation: 表面上；名义上
note: ostensible＝表面宣称的（未必属实）；辨析 ostentatious（炫耀的）。

raw: Though the kinds of phenomena are not very numerous, all the other considerations are ways the quant can differentiate his approach from those of others who are ostensibly looking for the same types of anomalies.
translation: 虽然（可利用的）现象种类并不多，但其余所有这些决策环节，都是量化交易者把自己的方法与那些表面上在寻找同类异象的同行区分开来的途径。
note: Though 让步从句；ways 后接省略 in which 的定语从句；those of others＝the approaches of others，代词避免重复。

raw: we have separately managed accounts
translation: 专户（SMA）
note: separately managed account＝投资者单独开设、委托管理人交易的账户，持仓对投资者透明。

raw: held in opposite directions on the exact same names
translation: 同一批股票（name＝个股）
note: name 在交易行话中指具体证券/标的；常见义「名字」。

raw: This belies the notion that quants are all the same
translation: 证明…不实；与…相矛盾
note: belie＝（事实）戳穿（说法）；并非 believe 的变体。

raw: With a third to a half of all potentially overlapping positions held in opposite directions, it is difficult to accept an argument that quants are all the same.
translation: 所有可能重叠的持仓中有三分之一到一半方向相反，这样一来就很难接受「量化都是一路货」的论调了。
note: With+名词+过去分词的独立结构作原因状语；it 为形式主语；that quants are all the same 是 argument 的同位语从句。

raw: ranging from convertibles to risk arb and macro strategies
translation: 可转债
note: convertibles＝可转换债券，可按约定条件转成股票；risk arb＝风险套利（并购套利），押注已公告并购完成赚取价差。

raw: the equity hedge and event-driven styles
translation: 事件驱动（策略）
note: 围绕并购、重组、破产等公司事件建仓的对冲基金风格。

raw: fund of funds indices
translation: 基金中的基金（FOF）
note: fund of funds＝把资金分散投给多只对冲基金的母基金。

raw: ONLY A FEW LARGE QUANTS CAN THRIVE IN THE LONG RUN
translation: 兴旺；发展壮大
note: thrive＝茁壮成长、繁荣；辨析 strive（努力）。

raw: outperform their smaller cousins
translation: 同类；同行
note: cousin 本句为比喻「同类机构」；常见义「表亲」。

raw: fall by the wayside
translation: 掉队；被淘汰
note: 源自《圣经》撒种比喻：落在路边的种子无法生根。

raw: either underperformance or investor attrition
translation: 流失；损耗
note: attrition＝逐渐消耗（客户流失、人员减员）；war of attrition＝消耗战。

raw: The best shops, furthermore, are so good that they ultimately replace their investors' capital with their own, leaving the investor who desires to invest in quant trading in a quandary
translation: 更有甚者，最优秀的机构好到最终会用自有资金替换掉投资者的资金（不再接受外部投资），让想投量化的投资者陷入两难。
note: so…that 结果从句；leaving…现在分词作结果状语；quandary＝进退两难，in a quandary 固定搭配；who desires…定语从句嵌在 the investor 与 in a quandary 之间。

raw: if they kick out their investors later, so be it
translation: 那就随它吧
note: so be it＝虚拟语气残留，表示无奈接受；kick out＝赶走。

raw: simply avoid this space altogether
translation: 这个领域；赛道
note: space 本句为行业用语「细分领域」；常见义「空间」。

raw: This criticism and its corollaries
translation: 推论；必然结果
note: corollary＝由主命题自然推出的结论，数学用语。

raw: one sacrifices nimbleness while gaining size and resources
translation: 灵活性
note: nimble（敏捷的）的名词形式；指大资金调仓笨重、失去灵活。

raw: extremely costly in times of stress
translation: 在市场承压时期
note: in times of＝在…时期；stress 此处指市场压力，非「精神压力」。

raw: they cannot put enough money to work there
translation: 把钱投出去；让资金发挥作用
note: put money to work＝让资金进场产生回报。

raw: has very limited capacity
translation: （策略）容量
note: capacity＝策略在收益未明显衰减前所能容纳的资金规模。

raw: become complacent or uninvolved
translation: 自满的；安于现状的
note: complacent（自满）≠ complaisant（殷勤顺从）。

raw: any more an impediment for quants
translation: 障碍
note: impediment＝阻碍（正式）；speech impediment＝语言障碍。

raw: As one small discretionary trader put it
translation: 如此说道；这样表述
note: put it＝措辞、表达，put 的熟词僻义。

raw: Regardless, there isn't a particularly good reason to believe that the lack of resources any small trader faces, relative to those who are much larger and trade similar strategies, is any more an impediment for quants than for discretionary traders.
translation: 无论如何，没有充分理由认为：小机构相对于规模大得多、策略相似的同行所面临的资源匮乏，对量化交易者的阻碍会比对主观交易者更大。
note: that 从句的主语 the lack of resources 带省略关系词的定语从句 any small trader faces；relative to…为插入比较；any more…than 比较结构横跨全句。

raw: to build on success, a larger trader must incorporate other strategies
translation: 在（成功）基础上更进一步
note: build on＝以…为基础扩展；incorporate＝纳入。

raw: is mixed at best
translation: 充其量好坏参半
note: mixed＝正反证据都有；at best 进一步压低评价。

raw: The so-called 80–20 rule
translation: 二八定律（帕累托法则）
note: 80%的价值来自20%的资源或人员；源自帕累托对财富分布的观察。

raw: this may be suboptimal
translation: 次优的；不理想的
note: sub-（低于）+ optimal（最优）；委婉的批评用语。

raw: a great deal of (admittedly anecdotal) evidence
translation: 诚然；无可否认地
note: admittedly＝说话人先承认己方证据的弱点；anecdotal＝轶事性、非系统的。

raw: Instead of having a mathematician who doesn't understand software development (or hardware issues, or network optimization) and may not have a great deal of trading expertise or experience, it may be better to have senior partners whose skillsets span multiple areas relevant to quant trading (math, computer science, and finance).
translation: 与其要一个不懂软件开发（或硬件、网络优化）、也未必有多少交易经验的数学家，不如要几位技能横跨量化交易多个相关领域（数学、计算机科学、金融）的资深合伙人。
note: Instead of+动名词与 it may be better to 形成「与其…不如…」；who 从句内两个并列谓语；whose 从句修饰 partners；span＝横跨。

raw: The jargon is almost always different, the approach to communicating can be different, the assumptions are often different, and, perhaps most importantly, the understanding of what problems can be solved (and what can't be solved) by people in other fields is simply not at a high enough level to maximize the efficiency of communication between specialists of differing fields.
translation: 行话几乎总是不同，沟通方式可能不同，假设也常常不同；或许最重要的是，各领域的人对「哪些问题能解决（哪些不能）」的理解水平不够高，以致无法让不同领域专家之间的沟通效率最大化。
note: 四个并列分句层层递进；末句主语为带 of what…宾语从句的长名词短语；not at a high enough level to…＝不足以…。

raw: trying to plug the holes in communication
translation: 堵住（沟通中的）漏洞
note: plug the holes＝补漏；plug 名词义「插头」。

raw: this energy was often spent in vain
translation: 徒劳地
note: in vain＝白费；vain 另义「虚荣的」。

raw: This is not an indictment of that particular group
translation: 控诉；谴责
note: indictment 本为法律术语「起诉书」（c 不发音），引申为严厉指责。

raw: a well-known problem endemic to any field
translation: （某领域）特有且普遍存在的
note: endemic to＝在某范围内固有流行；辨析 epidemic（爆发流行的）。

raw: expertise from a multitude of disciplines
translation: 大量的；众多的
note: a multitude of＝许多（正式）；multitude 亦指「人群」。

raw: competes favorably with a portfolio of larger quant managers
translation: 与…相比毫不逊色
note: compete/compare favorably with＝相比之下不吃亏。

raw: rely on data vendors
translation: 数据供应商
note: vendor＝供应商；数据商向机构出售行情、基本面等数据（如彭博、路透）。

raw: gained traction with previously unwilling investors
translation: 获得认可；打开局面
note: traction 本义轮胎抓地力，引申为想法或产品开始被接受。

raw: Investors vie for access to “hot” launches
translation: 争夺
note: vie for＝竞相争夺（vie with sb for sth）；launch 此处指新基金发行；hot＝抢手的。

raw: far from airtight
translation: （论证）无懈可击的
note: airtight 本义密不透风，引申为（论证、案子）无破绽；far from＝远谈不上。

raw: a great deal of expertise and firepower
translation: 实力；资源「火力」
note: firepower 军事比喻：机构的资金、人才、算力等综合实力。

raw: it boils down to an evaluation of managers
translation: 归结为
note: boil down to＝熬汤收汁的比喻，最终浓缩为；后文 bottom up＝自下而上逐个考察，与 top down 相对。

raw: no valid “top down” evidence
translation: 自上而下
note: top down＝从整体规律（如规模大小）作先验判断；与 bottom up（自下而上逐个考察）相对。

raw: Data mining is given a fairly bad name in financial circles
translation: 败坏…的名声
note: give sth a bad name＝使…名声不好；financial circles＝金融圈。

raw: It is used interchangeably with another term
translation: 可互换地
note: interchangeable＝可相互替换的；此处指 data mining 常被与 overfitting 混用。

raw: This is a fine line
translation: 微妙的界限
note: fine 此处＝细微的（a fine line between A and B）；不是「好」。

raw: The only discernible difference
translation: 可辨识的；看得出的
note: discern（辨别）+ -ible；辨析 discreet（谨慎的）与 discrete（离散的）。

raw: the primary subject of scrutiny
translation: 严格审查；细察
note: scrutiny＝逐项细查；under scrutiny＝受到审视。

raw: no one would espouse it as a valid approach
translation: 信奉；拥护
note: espouse＝公开支持（主义、观点）；与 spouse（配偶）同根，本义「迎娶」。

raw: rooting out potential terrorist activities
translation: 揪出；根除
note: root out＝连根拔起，强调彻底清除。

raw: to borrow again from the framework
translation: 借用（说法、框架）
note: borrow from 此处指借用概念表述；常见义「借钱/借物」。

raw: The only discernible difference is that, in theoretical science, a human is expected to derive an explanation that seems reasonable to other people, whereas in empirical science, the method of analyzing data is the primary subject of scrutiny.
translation: 唯一看得出的差别在于：理论科学要求人给出一个别人觉得合理的解释；而实证科学中，受到严格审视的首先是分析数据的方法。
note: is that…表语从句；whereas 引导前后对比；be expected to＝按惯例应当。

raw: focus on the most lucrative clients
translation: 高利润的；赚钱的
note: lucrative＝有利可图的；同根 lucre（钱财，贬义）。

raw: spend less time on less lucrative prospects
translation: 潜在客户
note: prospect 本句为销售术语「潜在客户」；常见义「前景」。

raw: lend themselves to data-mining
translation: 适合用于；便于
note: lend itself to＝（事物性质上）适合被用于；无「借出」义。

raw: it's largely a moot point
translation: 无实际意义的问题
note: moot point＝争了也白争的问题；moot 原指假设性辩论。

raw: Overfitting is another story entirely
translation: 完全是另一回事
note: another story＝性质完全不同的另一码事。

raw: the answer is, not bloody likely
translation: 门儿都没有；绝无可能
note: bloody 为英式加强语气词（略粗俗）；语出萧伯纳《卖花女》的著名台词。

raw: the Fed announcing rate hikes
translation: 加息
note: rate hike＝央行上调政策利率；hike 本义远足，引申为大幅上调。

raw: We could, if we were overfitting, draw a conclusion that Fed announcements are always bad, and this conclusion would be successful so long as future Fed announcements are met with the same reaction as past announcements.
translation: 如果我们在过拟合，就可能得出「美联储公告总是利空」的结论；只要未来的美联储公告引发与过去相同的市场反应，这个结论就还会灵验。
note: if we were overfitting 虚拟条件从句插在主句中间；that 同位语从句；so long as＝只要；be met with＝遭遇（某种反应）。

raw: idly clicked on a handful of books
translation: 漫不经心地；随手
note: idle（闲置的）的副词形式；辨析 idol（偶像）。

raw: Overfitting ignores this basic fact and burdens a limited supply of data too much, asking it to explain more than is realistic, given the amount of data.
translation: 过拟合无视这一基本事实，让本就有限的数据背上过重的负担，要求它解释超出实际可能的东西。
note: asking…现在分词作伴随状语；more than is realistic 中 than 兼作从句主语；given＝考虑到。

raw: These models are finely tuned to the past
translation: 精细调校的
note: fine-tune＝微调；tune 原指乐器调音、收音机调频。

raw: the moment that the future is out of step with the past
translation: 与…步调不一致；脱节
note: out of step＝行军步伐不齐的比喻；the moment that＝一…就…。

raw: the model breaks down
translation: 失效；崩溃
note: break down 本句义「（模型、关系）失灵」；常见义「（车）抛锚；分解」。

raw: a gross and incorrect generalization
translation: 粗略笼统的；严重的
note: gross 本句义「粗疏离谱的」；金融常见义「毛（收入）的」，口语另义「恶心的」。

raw: more amenable to data mining
translation: 适合…处理的
note: amenable to＝易于接受/适用于；本义「顺从的」。

raw: a useful rule of thumb
translation: 经验法则
note: rule of thumb＝不求精确、凭经验的粗略法则（相传源自木匠以拇指估长）。

raw: strategies with holding periods of less than a day
translation: 持有期
note: holding period＝一笔头寸从建仓到平仓的时间跨度。

raw: the number of betting periods is so small
translation: 押注周期
note: 指策略能独立「下注」的次数；次数太少则统计检验无从谈起。

raw: a hybrid approach that combines data-mining techniques and sound market theory
translation: 混合的
note: hybrid＝杂交、混合（hybrid car 混动车）；sound 此处＝扎实可靠的。

raw: But just as we do not reject analysis because some people are prone to overanalyzing things, we should not so quickly dismiss quantitative modeling (even data mining) just because it is possible (or even easy) for some people to do it badly.
translation: 正如我们不会因为有人爱过度分析就否定「分析」本身，我们也不应仅仅因为有人可能（甚至很容易）把量化建模做砸，就轻率否定量化建模（哪怕是数据挖掘）。
note: just as…, we should not…平行类比结构；两个 because 从句分别服务前后半句；be prone to＝易于。

raw: the (perhaps equally dangerous) pitfalls of underfitting
translation: 欠拟合
note: underfitting＝模型过于简单、未学到数据中的真实规律，与过拟合相对；pitfall＝隐蔽的陷阱。

raw: Quant trading is no magic elixir
translation: 灵丹妙药
note: elixir＝炼金术士的万能药、长生不老药。

raw: strategies that are commonplace and crowded
translation: 平庸常见的
note: commonplace 作形容词＝老生常谈、毫无新意的；名词义「陈词滥调」。

raw: the prognosis for the activity
translation: 预后；前景判断
note: prognosis 医学术语「预后」，引申为对前景的预测；辨析 diagnosis（诊断）。

raw: the difficulty of divining who will succeed
translation: 占卜；猜测
note: divine 作动词＝凭直觉推测（原指占卜）；形容词义「神圣的」。

raw: let's recap some salient points
translation: 概括最突出的几个要点
note: recap＝recapitulate 的缩略「小结」；salient＝最显著突出的。

raw: falling prey to the temptation of false precision
translation: 沦为…的猎物；受…之害
note: fall prey to＝被…捕获/坑害；false precision＝虚假精确。

raw: Quants must also remain aware of relationships within the market and must have a detailed understanding of the kinds of bets they are making and how they are expressing these bets in their portfolios, allowing them to navigate violent regime changes.
translation: 量化交易者还必须始终留意市场内部的关联，并详细理解自己在下什么样的注、以及这些注是如何在组合中表达的，这样才能安然渡过剧烈的市场状态切换。
note: 两个 must 并列；understanding of 后名词短语与 how 从句并列作宾语；allowing…分词作结果状语。

raw: gives some good color both on the regulatory and other sources of the problem
translation: 背景细节；补充信息
note: color 此处为金融/新闻行话「背景信息」（give color on…）；常见义「颜色」。

raw: The avocation of assessing the failures of better men can be turned into a comfortable livelihood, providing you can back it up with a Ph.D.
translation: 评判比自己强的人如何失败，这门副业可以变成一份舒服的谋生手段——只要你能拿个博士学位来撑腰。
note: 本章题记，出自美国小说家 Nelson Algren（1909—1981），讽刺以点评他人失败为业的评论者。

raw: avocation
translation: 副业；本职之外的营生
note: 与 vocation（本职、天职）相对；avocation 指正业之外的事，不是 vacation（假期）。

raw: providing you can back it up with a Ph.D.
translation: 只要你能拿个博士学位来撑腰
note: providing (that) 在此是连词，等于 provided that / as long as，引导条件从句，不是"提供"的分词形式；back it up = 为之提供支撑。

raw: separate the good from the mediocre and the mediocre from the poor
translation: 把优秀的与平庸的、平庸的与差劲的区分开
note: mediocre 平庸的（贬义）；the good / the mediocre / the poor 为"the+形容词"指一类人。

raw: has very natural analogues in discretionary trading
translation: 在主观交易里有非常自然的对应物
note: analogue 本句义"对应之物、可类比的做法"；常见义"模拟（信号）的"。

raw: significant parallels in the work of a quant trader to the work of a corporate CEO
translation: 量化交易员的工作与企业CEO的工作之间存在明显的相似之处
note: parallel 名词本句义"相似之处、类似点"；常见义"平行线"。

raw: various corporate bond offerings
translation: 各类公司债发行
note: offering 指证券的发行/发售，此处即企业发债募资。

raw: pierce the walls of secrecy that quants build around their methods
translation: 刺穿量化交易者围绕其方法筑起的保密之墙
note: pierce 本句义抽象的"突破、看穿"；常见义"刺穿（实物）"。

raw: It also owes to how we ask these questions
translation: 这也归因于我们提问的方式
note: owe to 本句义"归因于"（= be due to）；常见义"欠（钱、人情）"。

raw: It is critical to ascertain whether the quant team is skilled
translation: 查明；确定
note: ascertain = 通过查证把不确定的事弄清楚，比 make sure 更正式。

raw: the integrity of the people involved
translation: 相关人员的品行正直
note: integrity 本句义"正直、诚信"；常见义"完整性、完好无损"。

raw: In hedge fund parlance
translation: 用对冲基金圈的行话来说
note: parlance 指某个圈子/行业的特定说法；in ... parlance 是固定搭配。

raw: All these components of the analysis of a quant ultimately serve to help the evaluator answer perhaps the most central question in the evaluation of any kind of trader: Why should I believe that this particular team, utilizing this particular strategy, is actually likely to make money in the future?
translation: 对量化经理的这些分析环节，最终都是为了帮助评估者回答评价任何一类交易者时或许最核心的那个问题：我凭什么相信，这支特定的团队、用这套特定的策略，未来真的可能赚到钱？
note: 主干是 All these components ... serve to help the evaluator answer ... question；冒号后是 question 的同位语内容；utilizing this particular strategy 是修饰 team 的分词短语插入语。

raw: Quants are notorious for their secrecy and paranoia
translation: 量化交易者以保密和多疑而"出名"
note: be notorious for = 因某事出名，只用于负面；与 famous for 的褒义相对。

raw: their secrecy and paranoia
translation: 偏执多疑
note: paranoia 指过度怀疑他人图谋不轨的心态。

raw: And this is not without reason.
translation: 而且这并非没有道理。
note: not without = 双重否定表肯定，"不是没有…"，语气比 has reason 更含蓄。

raw: comes from experience and knowhow
translation: 来自经验和实操诀窍
note: knowhow（know-how）指实践中积累、难以言传的操作诀窍，与理论知识相对。

raw: There is an excellent book called The Interrogator, by Raymond Toliver
translation: 有一本很棒的书叫《审讯者》，作者是 Raymond Toliver
note: 该书写二战德国空军（Luftwaffe）审讯官 Hanns Joachim Scharff，他不用暴力、靠建立信任和掌握大量背景信息从盟军飞行员口中取得情报。

raw: downed Allied pilots
translation: 被击落的盟军飞行员
note: downed 本句义"被击落的"（down 作及物动词"击落"）；Allied 指二战同盟国一方。

raw: trust building, domain knowledge, and an organized system for tracking and retrieving information
translation: 建立信任、领域知识，以及一套有组织的信息追踪与检索系统
note: domain knowledge 指某一专门领域的内行知识，是提问者能问到点子上的前提。

raw: But there is one similarity, I believe, that allows lessons from the latter to be useful in the former: In both cases, information that one party is reluctant to provide is needed by the other.
translation: 但我认为两者有一点相似，正是它让后者的经验对前者有用：在这两种情形里，一方不愿提供的信息，恰恰是另一方需要的。
note: I believe 为插入语；the latter/the former 分别指前文提到的后者（审讯者与俘虏）和前者（投资人与量化经理），顺序与中文习惯相反。

raw: an actual propensity to talk about what other quants do
translation: 倾向；习性
note: propensity to do sth = 做某事的癖性，比 tendency 更正式。

raw: in the strictest confidence
translation: 以最严格的保密方式
note: confidence 本句义"保密"（in confidence = 私下地、不外传）；常见义"信心"。

raw: bits and pieces
translation: 零零碎碎的东西；零散片段
note: 固定搭配，指不成系统的零星部分。

raw: without compromising proprietary information
translation: 不泄露专有信息
note: compromise 本句义"泄露、危及（机密/安全）"；常见义"妥协"。proprietary = 独家的、不外传的。

raw: They were frequently lulled into thinking
translation: 他们常被哄得放松警惕，以为…
note: lull sb into (doing) sth = 使某人麻痹大意而做某事；lull 本义"哄睡"。

raw: since their captor knew so much already
translation: 俘获者；看押者
note: captor 与 captive（俘虏）是一对：前者抓人，后者被抓。

raw: blatant
translation: 公然的；明目张胆的
note: 形容毫不掩饰的（通常是不当的）行为。

raw: a similarly voluminous amount
translation: 海量的；篇幅浩大的
note: 源自 volume（卷、量），指数量或体量极大。

raw: obviates the need for most of the secrecy
translation: 使…变得没有必要
note: obviate the need for = 免去对…的需要，即让某事不再必要。

raw: the menu available to a quant
translation: 量化交易者可选的"菜单"
note: menu 在此为比喻义"可供选择的项目清单"，作者用它指本书列出的各种策略选项。

raw: whether they are relative or intrinsic
translation: 是相对型还是内生（绝对）型
note: 相对阿尔法比较标的之间的相对优劣（如配对交易）；内生阿尔法只根据标的自身特征给出预测。

raw: in what instruments and geographies
translation: 在哪些标的和哪些地域市场
note: geography 本句义复数"地域市场、所在区域"；常见义"地理学"。

raw: they had a dossier
translation: 档案；卷宗
note: dossier 指关于某人/某事汇编的成套材料。

raw: Keeping information organized furthers the goal
translation: 把信息管理得井井有条能推进这一目标
note: further 本句义为动词"促进、推进"；常见义为副词"更远、进一步"。

raw: a robust research pipeline
translation: 稳健的研究管线
note: research pipeline 指源源不断产出待检验想法、并逐步推进到上线的研究流程。

raw: a process wherein modules
translation: 在其中（= in which）
note: wherein 是正式书面语，等于 in which，常见于合同和学术写作。

raw: suddenly appear in production
translation: 突然出现在正式运行的系统里
note: production 本句义"生产环境、正式上线运行"（与研究/测试环境相对）；常见义"生产、产量"。

raw: sloppiness in the research process
translation: 马虎；草率
note: sloppy（马虎的）的名词形式。

raw: If every three months you ask a quant, for example, what types of research projects he is working on and what new pieces he has added to the model over the past three months, over time, you should see a rational life cycle that repeatedly takes a robust research pipeline and turns it into implemented improvements to the strategy.
translation: 举例来说，如果你每三个月就问一次量化经理：他在做哪些研究项目、过去三个月又往模型里加了哪些新模块，那么时间一长，你应该能看到一个合理的循环周期：研究管线里的储备被反复转化为策略上已落地的改进。
note: if 条件从句里套了两个 what 引导的宾语从句；over time 是主句的时间状语；that 定语从句修饰 life cycle，takes ... and turns it into ... 是并列谓语。

raw: you have to have carefully managed the information
translation: 你必须事先就已经细致管理好这些信息
note: have to have + 过去分词，表示"到这个时点为止早就必须已经完成"，动作先于当前时刻；句末 to begin with = 一开始就。

raw: Data sourcing, gathering, cleaning, and management
translation: 数据的来源获取、采集、清洗与管理
note: sourcing 指去哪里找到并买到数据；cleaning 指剔除错误值、拆并股调整等。

raw: Investment selection and structuring
translation: 投资标的选择与头寸构造
note: structuring 指决定用什么形式表达观点：做多还是做空、对谁做对冲、用什么工具。

raw: the myriad decisions
translation: 无数的
note: myriad 作形容词直接修饰名词，不接 of。

raw: an ad hoc approach is taken
translation: 采取临时随意的做法
note: ad hoc（拉丁语）本义"为此专设的"，引申为"没有章法、临时拍脑袋的"。

raw: scores of discretionary stock pickers
translation: 数十位主观选股型基金经理
note: score 本义"二十"，scores of = 几十个、大量；stock picker 指靠个人判断挑股票的经理。

raw: spin tremendous yarns
translation: 编出天花乱坠的故事
note: spin a yarn 为固定搭配，指绘声绘色地讲长故事，含"未必属实"的意味。

raw: vacuous
translation: 空洞的；言之无物的
note: 与 vacuum（真空）同源，指内容空空如也。

raw: Those charged with evaluating managers
translation: 那些负有评估基金经理之责的人
note: be charged with 本句义"被赋予（职责）"；常见义"被指控"。

raw: But when asked how they decide how to size these positions in their portfolios, the answers are often vacuous, given without deep thought or analysis.
translation: 但一问到他们如何决定这些头寸在组合里的大小，得到的回答往往空洞无物，既没有深入思考也没有分析。
note: when asked 是省略了主语和 be 的状语从句（= when they are asked）；size 在此作动词"确定…的规模"；given without ... 是修饰 answers 的过去分词短语。

raw: e.g., trend, reversion
translation: 例如趋势、均值回归
note: 作者对阿尔法策略风格的标准分类；reversion 即 mean reversion（均值回归）。

raw: in what investment universe
translation: 在哪个投资标的池里
note: investment universe 指策略允许交易的全部标的集合。

raw: objective function
translation: 目标函数
note: 组合构建时优化器要最大化（或最小化）的那个量，如夏普比率、收益/最大回撤比。

raw: intervene with your model
translation: 干预；介入
note: intervene 指中途插手打断原有进程；此处指人工推翻模型的决定。

raw: This is but a small sampling of the hundreds of questions
translation: 这不过是我会问的几百个问题中的一小部分样例
note: but 在此是副词"仅仅、不过"，等于 only，属正式书面用法；sampling 指抽样出来的一小撮。

raw: are sympathetic to the goals of an investor
translation: 理解并认同投资人的目的
note: sympathetic 本句义"认同、赞成（某目标）"；常见义"有同情心的"。

raw: It is largely laid out in this book
translation: 它在本书里已基本完整铺陈过了
note: lay out 本句义"清楚地摆出、系统阐述"；另有"布局、摊开"等义。

raw: the footprint left behind by the strategy
translation: 策略留下的"足迹"
note: footprint 比喻策略在市场数据里留下的可观察痕迹，此处即其收益历史。

raw: should corroborate the fundamental understanding
translation: 印证；佐证
note: corroborate 指用另一独立证据来支持已有结论。

raw: Imagine that an investor learns, by asking many questions such as those I’ve listed, that a quant is using a trend-following strategy on various individual instruments, with a six-month average holding period.
translation: 设想有位投资人通过问一大堆类似我上面列出的问题，得知某量化经理在多个单一标的上运行一套趋势跟踪策略，平均持仓周期为六个月。
note: learns 与其宾语从句 that a quant is using ... 被插入语 by asking many questions ... 隔开；with 短语补充说明策略的持仓周期。

raw: ACUMEN
translation: 敏锐的判断力；才干
note: business/investment acumen 指在某领域快速做出准确判断的能力。

raw: pervades the strategy she builds
translation: 遍布；渗透进
note: pervade 为及物动词，直接跟宾语，不加 in/through。

raw: easier said than done
translation: 说来容易做来难
note: 固定表达，主语常为前文提到的那件事。

raw: From a dispositional standpoint
translation: 从性情/秉性的角度来看
note: disposition 指人的性格倾向；standpoint = 立场、角度。

raw: in light of the massive array of subtleties and traps
translation: 鉴于；考虑到
note: in light of = 考虑到（某事实）；an array of = 一大堆、一系列。

raw: polluted data
translation: 被污染的数据（脏数据）
note: polluted 本句义"含错误、被污染的（数据）"；常见义指环境污染。

raw: by extension
translation: 推而广之；由此引申
note: 用于从已提到的事物顺势推及与之相连的事物。

raw: a source of potential differentiation from other traders
translation: 差异化；与他人拉开区别
note: differentiation 此处指做法上的区别，不是微积分的"求导"。

raw: turn these positions over relatively frequently
translation: 相当频繁地把这些头寸换手
note: turn over 本句义"（把持仓）换掉、周转"；常见义"翻转、移交"。名词 turnover 即换手率。

raw: The reality is, however, that evaluating whether scientists know what they are talking about at a deep level is not the easiest task for someone who is not technically proficient.
translation: 然而现实是：对技术上并不精通的人来说，判断科学家们是否真的懂行绝非易事。
note: 主干为 The reality is that ...，however 作插入语；that 从句的主语是动名词短语 evaluating whether ...；not the easiest 是"绝非易事"的委婉说法。

raw: they put on $2 of long positions
translation: 他们建立2美元的多头头寸
note: put on a position = 建仓、把头寸挂上去；反义为 take off / unwind。

raw: $400 million in dollar volume each day
translation: 每天4亿美元的成交金额
note: dollar volume 指按金额计的成交量（股数×价格），区别于按股数计的 share volume。

raw: optimize her executions such that she makes 0.01 percent more per dollar traded
translation: 优化她的执行，使得每交易一美元能多赚0.01%
note: such that 引导结果状语从句，"以至于/使得"；per dollar traded 中 traded 是后置的过去分词定语。

raw: plainly incorrect at a high level
translation: 在大方向上就明显做错了
note: at a high level 本句义"在宏观、粗颗粒度的层面"，与后文 at a fairly detailed level 相对；不是"高水平地"。

raw: comes down to his decisions at a fairly detailed level
translation: 归结为；最终取决于
note: come down to = 归根结底在于某事。

raw: skew the size of winning trades versus losing trades slightly
translation: 使赢单与输单的规模稍微向一边倾斜
note: skew 本句义动词"使偏斜、使分布偏向一侧"；名词 skew 指分布的偏度。

raw: Quants often depend on being right only slightly more often than they are wrong and/or on making only slightly more on winning trades than they lose on losing trades in order to generate profits (though trend-following futures strategies tend to lose as much as 70 percent of the time, with dramatically larger payoffs on the winners than the losses suffered on the losers).
translation: 量化交易的盈利往往只靠"对的次数比错的略多"和/或"赢单赚的比输单亏的略多"（不过趋势跟踪期货策略可能有高达70%的时间在亏损，只是赢单的回报远大于输单的亏损）。
note: depend on A and/or on B 为并列结构，A、B 均为动名词短语；in order to generate profits 是目的状语，作用于整个 depend 结构；括号内 with 短语表伴随情况。

raw: the details of the few areas that you spot-check
translation: 抽查
note: spot-check = 随机挑几处做检查，以此推断整体质量。

raw: rigor is a key component of success
translation: 严谨；缜密
note: rigor（英式 rigour）指做研究一丝不苟、方法严密。

raw: some of the biggest failures in quant trading have won Nobel Prizes
translation: 量化交易史上一些最惨的失败者还得过诺贝尔奖
note: 暗指 LTCM：其合伙人 Merton 与 Scholes 于1997年获诺贝尔经济学奖，基金1998年即崩盘。

raw: revealed to an investor during due diligence
translation: 尽职调查
note: due diligence（DD）指投资前对管理人、策略、运营的系统性核查。

raw: somewhat more reticent to provide such details
translation: 缄默的；不愿多说的
note: reticent about/to do = 对某事守口如瓶；与 reluctant（不情愿的）形近义近但侧重"不肯开口"。

raw: pass judgment on them
translation: 对它们作出评判
note: pass judgment on = 下判断、作出评价（常含"有资格评判"的意味）。

raw: divine the quality
translation: 推断出；揣摩出
note: divine 本句义为动词"凭蛛丝马迹推测出"；常见义为形容词"神圣的"。

raw: clues about its particulars
translation: 关于其细节的线索
note: particulars 复数名词义"详细情况、具体细节"；单数 particular 常作形容词"特定的"。

raw: seem plausible enough at first glance
translation: 貌似有理的
note: plausible 指表面上说得通、听着合理，未必真成立；at first glance = 乍一看。

raw: just because a quant pays a lot of money to a data vendor for clean data
translation: 仅仅因为某量化经理花大钱向数据商买"干净"数据
note: just because ... , it doesn't mean ... 是口语化的让步结构：不能由前一事实推出后一结论。

raw: The saving grace for the non-quantitative investor
translation: 可取之处；能挽回局面的一点
note: saving grace 指某人某事虽有诸多不足，但有一点足以补救。

raw: a key issue to focus on is the idea of an edge
translation: 优势（edge）
note: edge 在此定义为"使胜算偏向该经理的东西"，来源有三：投资流程、缺乏竞争、结构性因素。

raw: puts the odds in favor of the portfolio manager succeeding
translation: 使胜算偏向该基金经理
note: odds 指赔率/几率；in favor of = 有利于。

raw: more intrinsic than comparative
translation: 更多是自身固有的，而非比较得来的
note: intrinsic 本句义"内在固有的"（与 comparative 相对），不同于前文"内生阿尔法"里的用法。

raw: A valid idea with a valid implementation might make little or no money if there is too much competition, whereas a mediocre strategy might make money if there is none.
translation: 一个有效的想法配上有效的落地实现，若竞争过于激烈，也可能几乎不赚钱；反过来，一个平庸的策略，若完全没有竞争，倒可能赚到钱。
note: whereas 表前后对比，"反之、而"；句末 if there is none 中 none 回指 competition，即 if there is no competition。

raw: one more point bears mentioning
translation: 还有一点值得一提
note: bear 在此义为"值得、经得起"，常见于 bear mentioning / bear repeating / bear scrutiny。

raw: How a quant deals with adversity
translation: 逆境；不顺的处境
note: adversity 指持续的困难时期，此处指策略持续亏钱的阶段。

raw: a knee-jerk reaction
translation: 下意识的应激反应
note: knee-jerk 本义"膝跳反射"，比喻不经思考的条件反射式反应。

raw: A sound approach
translation: 稳妥而合理的做法
note: sound 本句义形容词"稳健的、站得住脚的"；常见义"声音"。

raw: pinpoint problems
translation: 精确定位问题
note: pinpoint 本句义动词"准确找出（位置/原因）"；名词义为"针尖"。

raw: several hallmarks of a high-quality process
translation: 标志性特征
note: hallmark 本义为贵金属上的纯度印记，引申为"典型标志"。

raw: vigorous and prolific
translation: 有力而多产的
note: prolific 指产出数量多且持续；vigorous 指强度大、劲头足。

raw: overfitting
translation: 过拟合
note: 模型把样本里的噪声也当规律学了进去，样本内表现漂亮而样本外失效。

raw: geolocational data derived from GPS signals on cell phones
translation: 由手机GPS信号得到的地理定位数据
note: 一种另类数据（alternative data），可用来实时估算客流、产量等宏观或微观指标。

raw: a data edge
translation: 数据优势
note: 凭借独有的数据来源，或更强的数据采集、清洗、存储能力而获得的优势。

raw: the care with which a manager has developed the entirety of an investment strategy
translation: 一位经理在打磨整套投资策略时所下功夫的细致程度
note: "介词+which"引导的定语从句：with which 还原后即 a manager has developed ... with the care；the entirety of = 整个、全部。

raw: This is because most quant models eventually decay into mediocrity, and successful ongoing research must be implemented in live trading strategies to stay ahead of this decay.
translation: 这是因为大多数量化模型最终都会衰减到平庸，因此必须把持续研究的成果落到实盘策略里，才能跑在这种衰减前面。
note: decay into 表示"逐渐退化成…"；不定式 to stay ahead of this decay 表目的；stay ahead of = 领先于、抢在…前面。

raw: It is a truism in economics that
translation: 经济学里有条不言自明的道理：
note: truism 指人人皆知、无需论证的老生常谈；与 truth（真理）同根但强调“不值一提的显然”。

raw: It is a truism in economics that, if higher-than-average profit margins can be had in some activity, more and more players will compete until the margins compress and normalize at levels more typical in the broader marketplace.
translation: 经济学里有条不言自明的道理：如果某项活动能获得高于平均的利润率，就会有越来越多的玩家进来竞争，直到利润率被压缩、回落到整个市场更常见的水平。
note: It 为形式主语，that 从句是真主语；从句内部 if 条件句在前，主句 more and more players will compete 后接 until 时间状语；can be had 是 have 的被动式，意为“可以取得”。

raw: the margins compress and normalize
translation: （利润率）被压缩、回落到常态
note: compress 本句义“（利润空间）收窄”；常见义“压缩（文件、体积）”。normalize 本句义“回归正常水平”。

raw: players vacate the space
translation: （参与者）撤出这一领域
note: vacate 本句义“退出、腾空（某个市场领域）”；常见义“搬离（房屋）”。space 本句义“（业务）领域”，非“空间”。

raw: leaving more of the pie (and therefore better margins again) for the fewer players who remain
translation: 把更大一块蛋糕（以及随之回升的利润率）留给剩下的少数玩家
note: pie 喻可分的总利润；leave sth for sb 把某物留给某人。

raw: more difficult for new entrants
translation: 对新进入者来说更难
note: entrant 进入者、参赛者；此处指新进入某市场的竞争对手，与 entrance（入口）同根。

raw: they had to branch into other areas
translation: 他们不得不拓展进入其他领域
note: branch into 从主干业务分岔进入新领域；与 branch out（向外扩张）近义。

raw: their edge, which was largely related to a lack of competition, was eroded
translation: 他们那种主要靠“缺乏竞争”得来的优势被侵蚀殆尽
note: erode 本句义“（优势、价值）被逐步侵蚀”；常见义“（水土）侵蚀”。edge 本句义“（交易上的）优势”。

raw: caused a massive drawdown in their fund
translation: 导致基金出现巨额回撤
note: drawdown（回撤）指净值从阶段高点跌到低点的幅度，是衡量策略风险的核心指标。

raw: these are among the most fleeting kinds of edges
translation: 这类优势属于最转瞬即逝的一种
note: fleeting 短暂易逝的；among the most... 属于最…之列，是英文常见的弱化最高级说法。

raw: Structural edges
translation: 结构性优势
note: 指来自市场结构或交易身份（而非投资判断）的优势，通常由监管造就、也由监管消除。

raw: puts the wind in the sails of a market participant
translation: 为某个市场参与者扬帆助力；让他顺风顺水
note: 航海比喻：给帆灌满风；与 take the wind out of sb's sails（挫某人锐气）方向相反。

raw: a trader in the pits of the New York Mercantile Exchange
translation: 纽约商品交易所场内交易池里的一名交易员
note: pit 本句义“（交易所的）交易池、公开喊价场”；常见义“坑、深洞”。

raw: liquidity provision, or the rebate, on ECNs
translation: 在 ECN 上提供流动性所得的返佣
note: ECN（电子通信网络）对挂单提供流动性的一方给予返佣，使“成交这一行为本身”成为收入来源。

raw: payments by ECNs for order flow will dwindle
translation: ECN 为订单流支付的费用会逐渐减少
note: dwindle 指数量逐步缩减直至微不足道；order flow（订单流）指送到某场所成交的客户订单。

raw: this edge, too, will be eradicated
translation: 这种优势也会被彻底消除
note: eradicate 连根拔除、根除，语气比 remove 强；来自拉丁语 radix（根）。

raw: on a “trust, but verify” basis
translation: 本着“信任，但要核实”的原则
note: 源自俄语谚语，因里根在美苏裁军谈判中反复引用而成为英语常用语。

raw: Here we have a few tools at our disposal
translation: 在这方面我们有几种可用的手段
note: at one's disposal 供某人支配、可随时动用；disposal 此处非“处置垃圾”义。

raw: should probably serve as a red flag
translation: 多半应视为一个危险信号
note: red flag 警讯、危险信号；serve as 充当、起到…的作用。

raw: this is a tricky proposition
translation: 这是件棘手的事
note: proposition 本句义“要应付的事情、难题”；常见义“提议；命题”。

raw: the mistakes or misdeeds in a quant’s past
translation: 量化经理过往的错误或劣迹
note: misdeed 由 mis-（错误、不良）+ deed（行为）构成，指不端行为。

raw: The investor must determine whether the mistakes or misdeeds in a quant’s past served to “teach her a lesson,” or whether they indicate a likely pattern of behavior that will repeat, even if not in exactly the same way.
translation: 投资者必须判断：量化经理过去的错误或劣迹究竟是让她吸取了教训，还是预示着一种很可能重演（即便形式不完全相同）的行为模式。
note: determine 后接两个并列的 whether 宾语从句；serve to do 起到…作用；that will repeat 修饰 pattern；even if not... 为省略式让步状语。

raw: as a potential fiduciary, acting on behalf of the investor
translation: 作为代投资者行事的潜在受托人
note: fiduciary（受托人）在法律上负有为委托人最大利益行事的信义义务；on behalf of 代表。

raw: Fiduciaries are bound to act in their clients’ best interest
translation: 受托人必须以客户的最大利益行事
note: be bound to 本句义“（受法律或义务）约束而必须”；常见义“必定会（发生）”。

raw: to be very open and upfront about any potential conflicts of interest
translation: 对任何潜在利益冲突都非常坦诚、直言不讳
note: upfront 坦率的、事先讲明的；conflict of interest 利益冲突。

raw: anything else that could impede their fulfilling their duties
translation: 任何可能妨碍他们履行职责的事情
note: impede 阻碍、妨碍（进程）；后接动名词复合结构 their fulfilling。

raw: Using the mentality of the fiduciary as a compass
translation: 把受托人的思维方式当作指南针
note: compass 本句义“（判断方向的）准绳、指引”；常见义“罗盘；圆规”。

raw: More helpful still is to seek out references that the manager did not provide herself
translation: 更有帮助的做法是，找到并非由该经理自己提供的推荐人
note: 表语前置引起主谓倒装：正常语序为 To seek out... is more helpful still；still 在比较级后表“更加”。

raw: even someone intent on deceiving
translation: 即便是存心行骗的人
note: intent 本句为形容词，intent on doing 一心想做某事；常见义为名词“意图”。

raw: to be facile in answering questions about them
translation: 能对这些问题对答如流
note: facile 轻松流利的（有时含“流于表面”的贬义）；与 facility（才能、便利）同根。

raw: Though even less-skilled quants might have answers at hand for higher-level questions about their strategies and process, even someone intent on deceiving rarely thinks through low-level details sufficiently to be facile in answering questions about them.
translation: 尽管技艺较差的量化经理也可能对策略和流程的高层次问题有现成答案，但即便是存心欺骗的人，也很少会把低层细节想得足够透彻，以至于能流利回答关于细节的提问。
note: Though 引导让步状语从句；主句中 rarely 置于动词前表否定；sufficiently to do 表“足以做到…”，与前面 thinks through 搭配。

raw: a common and successful interrogation technique in law enforcement
translation: 执法领域一种常见且有效的审讯技巧
note: interrogation 审讯（比 questioning 正式且带强制意味）；law enforcement 执法（机关）。

raw: quickly and convincingly provide an alibi
translation: 迅速而令人信服地给出不在场证明
note: alibi 源自拉丁语“在别处”，指证明案发时人在他处的辩解。

raw: making up answers to questions about details on the fly
translation: 临场现编关于细节问题的答案
note: make up 编造；on the fly 在飞行中→引申为“即时、临场、边做边定”。

raw: these questions he likely has not rehearsed beforehand
translation: 这些他多半没有事先演练过的问题
note: rehearse 本句义“事先排练、打好腹稿”；常见义“（戏剧）排演”。

raw: these answers also have to be able to stand up on their own
translation: 这些回答本身还必须站得住脚
note: stand up 本句义“经得起推敲、成立”（如 stand up in court）；on their own 单独看、就其本身而言。

raw: answers that are internally inconsistent or are deficient in other ways
translation: 自相矛盾或在其他方面有欠缺的回答
note: internally inconsistent 内部自相矛盾；deficient 有缺陷的、不足的，与 sufficient 相对。

raw: It should not take much to say “no,” in other words, whereas it should take an incredible amount of confidence to say “yes.”
translation: 换言之，说“不”不该费多大力气，而说“是”则该需要极大的把握。
note: 两处 it takes... to do 句型（做某事需要…）；whereas 引导对比状语从句，前后形成不对称的门槛对照。

raw: who her dissertation committee included
translation: 她的博士论文答辩委员会有哪些人
note: dissertation（博士）学位论文，美式用法中比 thesis 更常指博士论文；committee 此处为论文指导/答辩委员会。

raw: verifiable with her alma mater
translation: 可以向她的母校核实
note: alma mater 拉丁语“慈母”，英语中固定指毕业院校。

raw: I would put forth that
translation: 我想提出这样一个看法：
note: put forth 提出（主张、观点），比 propose 更书面；另有“长出（枝叶）”义。

raw: Bernie Madoff and the other scandals that were announced on a nearly weekly basis in late 2008
translation: 麦道夫案以及2008年末几乎每周都在曝光的其他丑闻
note: Madoff 以稳定正回报吸引资金、实为庞氏骗局，2008年底败露；on a weekly basis 每周一次地。

raw: maintaining that his strategy
translation: （他）坚称自己的策略…
note: maintain 本句义“坚称、主张”；常见义“维护、保养”。

raw: was too proprietary
translation: 太过机密、属于独门专有
note: proprietary 本句义“专有的、不外传的”；金融语境另有“自营的”（proprietary trading）义。

raw: Though insufficient to uncover all potentially fraudulent (or simply unprofitable) investments
translation: 尽管不足以揪出所有可能的欺诈（或仅仅是不赚钱的）投资
note: Though + 形容词的省略式让步结构（省去 they are）；fraudulent 欺诈的，名词为 fraud。

raw: in conjunction with an equally rigorous operational due diligence process
translation: 与同样严格的运营尽职调查流程配合使用
note: in conjunction with 与…结合、配合；operational due diligence 运营尽调，专查后台、估值、托管、合规等非投资环节。

raw: being victimized by fraud, malfeasance, or other misbehavior
translation: 沦为欺诈、渎职或其他不当行为的受害者
note: malfeasance 指受托者的违法失职行为；victimize 使成为受害者。

raw: balancing the levels of various types of exposures
translation: 平衡各类敞口的水平
note: exposure（敞口）指组合对某一风险来源的暴露程度；组合构建本质即在各类敞口间取舍。

raw: trend, reversion, technical sentiment, value/yield, growth, and quality
translation: 趋势、回归、技术情绪、价值/收益率、成长、质量
note: 作者对 alpha 来源的分类：前两类基于价格，后几类基于基本面；technical sentiment 指由持仓、资金流等技术面反映的市场情绪。

raw: A quant doing trend following is not likely to be so incredibly different, from a portfolio construction viewpoint, than a discretionary trader who is seeking to identify trends.
translation: 从组合构建的角度看，一个做趋势跟踪的量化交易者，与一个试图识别趋势的主观交易者，多半并没有那么天差地别。
note: 主干 A quant... is not likely to be so different than B；from a... viewpoint 为插入语；different than 是美式口语用法（英式多用 different from）。

raw: the tireless vigilance of a computerized trading strategy
translation: 计算机化交易策略不知疲倦的警觉
note: vigilance 警觉、时刻监视；tireless 不知疲倦的（tire + -less）。

raw: out of naiveté
translation: 出于天真无知
note: naiveté（法语借词）天真、缺乏经验；out of + 名词表动机“出于…”。

raw: But, as trend following in general goes, so it is likely that the human and computerized trader both go.
translation: 趋势跟踪这一大类整体表现如何，人工与电脑趋势交易者多半也一起如何。
note: as... so... 对应结构（正如…，也就…）；go 在此表“（形势）发展、走向”，如 as goes X, so goes Y。

raw: the blended allocations to various types of alpha
translation: 对各类 alpha 的混合后总配置
note: blended 本句义“混合汇总后的”；常见义“（食物）搅拌的”。allocation 资金配置比例。

raw: in line with the levels that the investor has determined are desirable
translation: 与投资者认定为理想的水平相一致
note: in line with 与…一致、相符；that... 从句中 the investor has determined 为插入的主谓，真正谓语是 are desirable。

raw: single-instrument bets
translation: 单标的下注
note: 只押某一标的自身涨跌，与 relative bets（押两标的相对强弱）相对。

raw: counting on the stability of the relationships among the instruments
translation: 指望各标的之间关系保持稳定
note: count on 本句义“依赖、指望”；count 常见义“数数”。

raw: relative mean reversion strategies are prone to losses
translation: 相对型均值回归策略容易亏损
note: be prone to 易于（发生不好的事）；mean reversion 均值回归：押价格向历史均值回归。

raw: large regime changes
translation: 市场状态的大幅切换
note: regime（市场状态/机制）指波动率、相关性等统计特征相对稳定的一段时期；切换时依赖历史关系的策略最易受伤。

raw: This is because this strategy tends to bet against the prevailing trend while remaining indifferent to the destabilizing effects of a large trend reversal on the relationships depended on by a relative alpha strategy.
translation: 这是因为该策略倾向于逆着现行趋势下注，同时并不在意趋势大反转对标的间关系的破坏——而相对型 alpha 策略恰恰依赖这些关系。
note: while 引导伴随状语（remaining 现在分词）；effects of A on B 结构中 A = a large trend reversal，B = the relationships；depended on by... 为后置的被动分词短语修饰 relationships。

raw: the destabilizing effects of a large trend reversal
translation: 趋势大反转带来的破坏稳定的效应
note: destabilize = de-（去）+ stabilize（使稳定）；trend reversal 趋势反转。

raw: This is but one example of how bet structures can impact results
translation: 这只是下注结构影响结果的一个例子
note: but 本句义为副词“仅仅、只不过”（= only）；常见义为转折连词“但是”。

raw: relative and intrinsic mean reversion
translation: 相对型与内在型（单标的）均值回归
note: intrinsic 指押标的自身价格回归，relative 指押两个标的价差回归，二者风险来源不同。

raw: longer and streakier performance cycles
translation: 更长、更“一阵一阵”的业绩周期
note: streaky 由 streak（连续的一串好运/背运）派生，指表现成片扎堆、时好时坏。

raw: for several quarters on end
translation: 连续好几个季度
note: on end 接连不断地（如 for hours on end）；另有“竖立着”义。

raw: they are subject to crowding risk
translation: 它们会受到拥挤交易风险的影响
note: crowding risk（拥挤风险）指过多资金持有同类头寸，一旦同时平仓会引发踩踏式亏损；be subject to 易受…影响。

raw: as seen so vividly in August 1998 and August 2007
translation: 正如1998年8月和2007年8月所鲜明呈现的那样
note: vividly 本句义“（事例）鲜明、活生生地”；常见义“（色彩）鲜艳地”。

raw: Many traders are tempted to grow their assets when assets are available
translation: 许多交易者一有钱可募就忍不住想把规模做大
note: be tempted to do 受诱惑去做；grow 此处为及物动词“使…增长”。

raw: As with all things related to portfolios
translation: 与组合相关的一切事情一样
note: as with 就像…的情况一样，用于类比引出下文。

raw: these considerations closely mirror the taxonomy of theory-driven alphas
translation: 这些考量与理论驱动型 alpha 的分类体系高度呼应
note: mirror 本句义为动词“与…如出一辙、映照”；常见义为名词“镜子”。taxonomy 分类体系。

raw: the investment universe (asset class, instrument class, or geography)
translation: 投资范围（资产类别、工具类别或地域）
note: universe 本句义“可投资标的的全集”；常见义“宇宙”。

raw: various other subtleties
translation: 其他各种细微差别
note: subtlety 微妙之处、细微区别，形容词 subtle。

raw: model specification or run frequency
translation: 模型设定或运行频率
note: model specification 指模型的具体形式与变量选择；run frequency 指模型多久重算一次。

raw: are particularly impactful in portfolio construction
translation: 在组合构建中特别有影响力
note: impactful 影响显著的（由 impact 派生的现代用法）；此处非“冲击力强”的物理义。

raw: distinctions along the lines of the three portfolio considerations
translation: 按照上述三条组合考量思路作出的区分
note: along the lines of 按照…的思路/路线；distinction 区分、差别。

raw: the quality and vigor of the process
translation: 流程的质量与力度
note: vigor 精力、劲头，此处指研究流程的强度与旺盛程度；形容词 vigorous。

raw: extract and piece together information
translation: 把信息挖出来并拼凑成完整图景

raw: Ultimately, an investor has to determine whether a quant has an edge, what the sources of this edge are, how sustainable the edge is, and what could threaten it in the future.
translation: 归根结底，投资者必须判断：这位量化交易者是否有优势、优势来源何在、这种优势能持续多久、以及未来什么可能威胁到它。

raw: Once quants have been vetted
translation: 一旦量化经理通过了审查

raw: bet structures to complement best the other components of the investor’s portfolio
translation: 用不同的下注结构去最好地补足组合中的其他部分

raw: one of the best quant shops in the world
translation: 全球最顶尖的量化机构之一

raw: I asked him how on earth they had done so well
translation: 我问他，他们究竟是怎么做得这么好的
note: how on earth 用于疑问句加强语气，表示困惑或惊讶（究竟、到底）。

raw: both concise and seemingly on target
translation: 既简明又似乎切中要害
note: on target 命中目标→引申为“说到点子上”；concise 简洁扼要。

raw: To quote him, loosely
translation: 大意引述他的话
note: loosely 此处指“不逐字、大致地”；与 to quote him verbatim（逐字引用）相对。

raw: There is no secret sauce.
translation: 没有什么秘方绝技。
note: secret sauce 源自快餐业的独家酱料，喻不可复制的独门诀窍。

raw: relentlessly work to improve everything we do
translation: 不懈地改进我们所做的每一件事
note: relentlessly 持续不放松地；形容词 relentless（不间断的、无情的）。

raw: The Interrogator: The Story of Hanns Scharff, Luftwaffe’s Master Interrogator
translation: 《审讯者：德国空军审讯大师汉斯·沙尔夫的故事》
note: Scharff 是二战德国空军审讯官，以闲聊套话、不用刑而闻名，其技巧至今被执法机构研究；Luftwaffe 即德国空军。

raw: The British author Tony Buzan popularized this concept
translation: 英国作家托尼·博赞使这一概念（思维导图）广为人知

raw: Porphyrius’s third-century explications of Plato’s teachings
translation: 波菲利在三世纪对柏拉图学说的阐释
note: explication 详细阐释（比 explanation 更书面、更强调逐层剖析）；Porphyrius 为新柏拉图主义哲学家。

raw: I’m so fast that last night I turned off the switch in my hotel room and was in bed before the room was dark.
translation: 我快到昨晚关掉旅馆房间的灯之后、房间还没黑我就已经躺上床了。

raw: fresh off of (a harrying near-Depression experience)
translation: 刚刚经历完…
note: fresh off 刚从…出来；off of 为美式口语中介词叠用。

raw: harrying
translation: 折磨人的；令人疲于奔命的
note: 动词 harry（不断袭扰、折磨）的分词作形容词；与 hurrying（匆忙）形近易混。

raw: a new breed of trading firms
translation: 新一类的；新品种的（交易公司）
note: breed 本义"（动物）品种"，引申指"类型、一代新事物"。

raw: so secretive as to make quant trading shops look like glass houses
translation: 保密到让量化交易公司相比之下都像玻璃房一样透明
note: so + 形容词 + as to do 表程度；glass house 玻璃房，喻毫无遮掩、一览无余。

raw: prompted a chorus of cries of “no fair”
translation: 引发异口同声的一片"不公平"喊声
note: chorus 本句义"齐声、异口同声"；常见义"合唱（团）；副歌"。

raw: What was most alarming to the public about this case had nothing to do with Aleynikov, Goldman, or Teza (intellectual property theft cases are almost never of interest to the broader public).
translation: 这桩案子最令公众警觉之处与 Aleynikov、高盛或 Teza 本身都无关（知识产权盗窃案几乎从来引不起大众兴趣）。

raw: The prosecuting attorney
translation: 公诉检察官
note: prosecute 起诉、检控；attorney 美式"律师/检察官"。

raw: in an effort to add weight to
translation: 为了给…增加分量；佐证
note: add weight to 给（指控、论点）加码使其更有分量。

raw: allegedly
translation: 据称；据指控
note: 表示"被指称但未经证实"；同根名词 allegations（指控）。

raw: manipulate markets in unfair ways
translation: 以不公平的方式操纵市场
note: market manipulation（市场操纵）是证券监管认定的核心违法行为；manipulate 操纵、摆布。

raw: eye-catching
translation: 抓人眼球的

raw: overturned and vacated by an appeals court
translation: 被上诉法院推翻并撤销
note: vacate 本句法律义"撤销（判决）"；常见义"腾空、搬离"；appeals court 上诉法院。

raw: the damage was done and the stage was set
translation: 伤害已然造成，大幕已经拉开
note: 两个被动短语并列：既成事实＋后续风波的铺垫已就绪；set the stage for 为…做铺垫。

raw: meltdown
translation: 崩盘；灾难性暴跌
note: 本义核反应堆堆芯熔毁，引申指市场的灾难性下跌。

raw: a fierce rally
translation: 一轮凶猛的反弹
note: rally 本句义"（价格）急速回升"；常见义"集会；拉力赛"。

raw: wiped out most of the 600-point loss
translation: 一举收复了600点跌幅的大部分
note: wipe out 本句"抹平（跌幅/亏损）"；另可指"彻底摧毁"。

raw: the Flash Crash
translation: 闪电崩盘（2010年5月10日）
note: 道指盘中暴跌逾千点、又在数十分钟内收复大半的事件；因高速发生而得名。

raw: it suffices to say that
translation: 足矣；只需说

translation: 冷门小众的市场

raw: lay people

raw: monolithic
translation: 铁板一块的；单一同质的

raw: homogeneous
translation: 同质的；清一色的

raw: an enormously diverse constituency
translation: 一个极其多元的构成群体

raw: The fastest HFTs (sometimes referred to as ultra-high-frequency traders, or UHFTs) will no doubt scoff at the notion that someone who holds positions for as much as six and a half hours should be considered high frequency.
translation: 最快的那批HFT（有时被称为超高频交易商UHFT）无疑会对"持仓长达六个半小时的人也算高频"这一说法嗤之以鼻。

raw: overnight risk and intraday risk
translation: 隔夜风险与日内风险

raw: arbitrary
translation: 武断的；任意划定的
note: 无客观依据、纯凭人为规定的。

raw: algorithmic execution engines
translation: 算法执行引擎
note: 替长线投资者把大额订单拆细、自动执行以降低冲击成本的算法系统。

raw: I know it when I see it
translation: （虽然定义不了）但我一看便知。

raw: a common footing when discussing the topic
translation: 讨论该话题时的共同立足点
note: footing 本句义"立足点、基础"；常见义"脚下站稳（lose one's footing）"。

raw: “flat,” in industry lingo
translation: 行话所说的"无持仓"（已平仓）

raw: tends to exactly offset
translation: 往往正好相互抵消

raw: incurs large market impact costs
translation: 招致巨大的市场冲击成本

raw: Unwinding such positions
translation: 把这些头寸平掉

translation: 幅度有限的

translation: 交易所为提供流动性支付的返佣

note: material 本句义（形容词）“重大的、有实质影响的”；常见义（名词）“材料”。

raw: To put some metrics on it
translation: 用具体数字来衡量一下
note: put metrics on 给…加上可量化的指标。

raw: let’s assume that this time is negligible for now
translation: 暂且假设这段时间可以忽略不计
note: negligible 微不足道的、可忽略的（动词 neglect 忽视）。

raw: at the 99th percentile
translation: 在第 99 百分位上
note: 百分位：把观测值排序后，99% 的观测低于该值；此处指最繁忙的那 1% 时段。

raw: posted to the various order books for EBAY
translation: 被报送到 EBAY 各个订单簿上的
note: post 本句义“报送、挂出（订单或消息）”；常见义“邮寄；张贴”。

raw: your orders will be very far behind other orders given the 100 millisecond delay
translation: 考虑到 100 毫秒的延迟，你的订单会远远落后于其他订单
note: given 此处是介词“考虑到、鉴于”，不是动词过去分词。

raw: we care far more about the message rate and activity at the 99th percentile than we do about the median level
translation: 我们更关心第 99 百分位上的消息速率与活跃度，而不是中位数水平
note: than we do 中的 do 代替前面的 care，避免重复；far more … than 构成比较。

raw: everything in between reside on servers
translation: 中间的一切都驻留在服务器上
note: reside 本句义“（软件、数据）驻留、存放于”；常见义“居住”。

raw: One possibility is to locate them on your own premises
translation: 一种做法是把它们放在自家场地上
note: premises 本句义“（公司的）房产、经营场所”，恒用复数；常见义“前提”。

raw: expensive, mission-critical servers
translation: 昂贵的关键任务级服务器
note: mission-critical 指一旦故障就会导致业务瘫痪的关键系统。

raw: data centers (also known as colocation facilities)
translation: 数据中心（也称托管机房）
note: colocation facility：向多家客户出租机柜空间、让其服务器与交易所比邻而居的设施。

raw: these consolidated data feeds contain substantial latency
translation: 这些整合后的行情源含有相当大的延迟
note: consolidated data feed：由第三方把多个交易场所行情合并后转发的数据源，比自建合并慢。

raw: can be visualized as a “mesh
translation: 可以想象成一张“网状结构”
note: mesh 网格、网状；此处指各交易所数据中心两两互连的拓扑形态。

raw: are very keen to know, with minimal latency
translation: 迫切想以最小延迟知道
note: be keen to 本句义“急切想要（做某事）”；keen 常见义“锋利的；敏锐的”。

raw: which generally trade in the vicinity of New York City
translation: 它们一般在纽约市附近交易
note: in the vicinity of 在…附近（正式书面语）。

raw: the S&P E-Mini futures contract (called the “ES” futures contract)
translation: 标普 500 小型（E-Mini）期货合约（业内称 ES 合约）
note: 芝加哥商品交易所上市的小合约版标普 500 指数期货，是全球最活跃的股指期货。

raw: the ES tends to lead both the SPY
translation: ES 往往领先于 SPY（先行反应）
note: lead 本句义“（价格）先行、领先反应”；常见义“带领”。

raw: Data can’t be beamed through the air
translation: 数据无法以光束形式在空中直传
note: beam 本句义（动词）“以波束/无线方式发送”；常见义（名词）“横梁；光束”。

raw: due to the curvature of the Earth
translation: 由于地球曲率
note: curvature 曲率、弯曲度（形容词 curved 弯曲的）。

raw: a one-way latency of seven to eight milliseconds
translation: 单向延迟七到八毫秒
note: one-way latency 单程延迟，与 round trip（往返）延迟相对，后者约为其两倍。

raw: This is over a fiber optic network, which (1) transmits data through glass (the material that fiber optics are essentially made from), and (2) is somewhat circuitous, as there is no telecommunications company with a direct route between Chicago and New York.
translation: 这是通过光纤网络实现的，而光纤网络 (1) 让数据在玻璃中传输（光纤基本上就是玻璃做的），(2) 路径有些绕，因为没有哪家电信公司拥有芝加哥到纽约的直达线路。
note: which 引导非限定性定语从句，其谓语被 (1)(2) 拆成两个并列部分；as 引导原因状语从句；circuitous 迂回绕路的。

raw: They leased and bought tracts of land along this path
translation: 他们沿这条路径租下并买下大片土地
note: tract 本句义“一片（土地）”；常见义“（学术）短论；（人体）道，如 digestive tract”。

raw: employed 126 four-person crews to lay a one-inch-wide line
translation: 雇了 126 支四人施工队来铺设一条一英寸宽的线路
note: crew 此处指施工班组；lay 铺设（管线），过去式 laid，勿与 lie（躺）混淆。

raw: contracts rumored to cost on the order of $10 million
translation: 传闻造价在 1000 万美元量级的合约
note: on the order of 大约在…数量级（口径上等于 roughly）。

raw: If this were somehow possible, it would take just under four milliseconds
translation: 如果这以某种方式可行，只需不到四毫秒
note: were + would 是与现在事实相反的虚拟语气；just under 略少于。

raw: this “arms race to zero”
translation: 这场“延迟趋零的军备竞赛”
note: 借冷战军备竞赛作比，指各家不断砸钱把延迟压向零的竞争。

raw: as the pursuit of minimum latency is less-than-affectionately known
translation: 追求最低延迟这件事被人不无揶揄地这样称呼
note: be known as 的插入式变体；less-than-affectionately 字面“毫无爱意地”，即带贬义、揶揄地。

raw: scarcely ended with Spread Networks’ unveiling
translation: 远未随着 Spread Networks 的亮相而结束
note: scarcely 几乎不、远非；unveiling 揭幕、正式推出（源自 unveil 揭开面纱）。

raw: a microwave solution (which bounces microwave transmissions between towers)
translation: 微波方案（在塔与塔之间接力反射微波信号）
note: 微波在空气中传播快于光在玻璃中传播，故延迟低于光纤，但带宽小、易受天气影响。

raw: microwaves tend to move faster through the air than photons move through glass
translation: 微波在空气中的传播快于光子在玻璃中的传播
note: photon 光子；此处 glass 指光纤的玻璃材质。

raw: There is some light (no pun intended) at the end of the tunnel
translation: 隧道尽头总算有点光亮（无意双关）
note: light at the end of the tunnel 喻困境将尽、转机在望；因本段正在谈光传输，作者自注双关。

raw: a closely monitored, dedicated fiber optic line
translation: 一条严密监控的专用光纤专线
note: dedicated line（专线）指只服务单一客户、不与他人共享带宽的线路。

raw: The “state-of-the-art” connection between London and New York
translation: 伦敦与纽约之间“最先进水平”的线路
note: state-of-the-art 代表当前最高技术水平的。

raw: This translates into a latency reduction of approximately 5 milliseconds
translation: 这相当于把延迟降低约 5 毫秒
note: translate into 转化为、意味着（某结果）。

raw: In general, the utility for reducing latency in communication between various markets (really, data centers) can be understood to be driven by the relationship between the instruments being traded in those disparate places.
translation: 总体而言，降低各市场（其实是各数据中心）之间通信延迟的价值，可以理解为取决于这些分散各地的场所所交易标的之间的关联关系。
note: 主语是 the utility for reducing latency…；can be understood to be driven by 为双重被动；being traded 是现在分词被动式作 the instruments 的后置定语；disparate 迥异的、分散各处的。

raw: There is not only a direct, one-to-one correspondence between the weighted sum of the underlying stocks in the index and the futures contract, as well as various ETFs that derive from the S&P 500 index, but also many indirect relationships as well.
translation: 不仅指数中成分股的加权和与期货合约（以及各种源自标普 500 指数的 ETF）之间存在直接的一一对应关系，还存在许多间接的关联。
note: not only … but also 分置句首与句尾；correspondence between A and B 表 A 与 B 一一对应；as well as 引出的插入成分把 ETF 并入 B 一侧。

raw: To the extent that you can garner a speed advantage
translation: 只要你能取得速度优势（能取得多少算多少）
note: to the extent that 在…限度内、只要；garner 获取、积累（正式）。

raw: you stand a better chance of profiting from these relationships
translation: 你就更有机会从这些关联中获利
note: stand a chance of doing 有做成某事的可能。

raw: in the form of messages (new orders, cancelations, and trades)
translation: 以消息（新订单、撤单、成交）的形式
note: 交易所推送的是逐条事件消息流，完整订单簿需由接收方自行重建。

raw: There can be no dropped messages.
translation: 一条消息都不能丢。
note: dropped 本句义“（数据包、消息）被丢失”；常见义“掉落的”。

raw: timestamping
translation: 打时间戳
note: 给每条消息标记精确到微秒的时间，用于还原跨场所事件的先后顺序。

raw: For markets that are fragmented (as in the case of U.S. equities)
translation: 对于碎片化的市场（如美国股市）
note: 市场碎片化：同一只证券在多个交易所与暗池并行交易，行情与流动性被分散。

raw: one consolidated order book
translation: 一本合并订单簿
note: 把多个交易场所的挂单按价格档位合并而成的统一订单簿。

raw: The challenges described above are compounded by the task of combining these multiple information sources correctly.
translation: 上述挑战又因“必须正确合并多个信息源”这项任务而进一步加剧。
note: compound 本句义“使加剧、雪上加霜”；常见义（金融）“以复利计算”。

raw: this must be accounted for when building the consolidated order book
translation: 在构建合并订单簿时必须把这一点计算在内
note: account for 本句义“把…考虑进去、作相应处理”；常见义“占（比例）；解释”。

raw: One of the most significant (and somewhat unique) challenges facing someone building a high-speed trading infrastructure is the fact that messages do not arrive at an even rate throughout the day.
translation: 搭建高速交易基础设施的人所面临的最重大（且颇为独特）的挑战之一，是消息在一天之中并非以均匀速率到达。
note: 主语 One of the … challenges 后接现在分词短语 facing someone building… 作定语（其中 building 又修饰 someone）；系动词 is 后接 the fact that 同位语从句。

raw: This is an extremely sneaky problem that bears some discussion.
translation: 这是个极其隐蔽狡猾的问题，值得展开讲一讲。
note: sneaky 暗中作祟、不易察觉的；bear discussion 值得讨论。

raw: rates of consumption of bandwidth would be basically stationary
translation: 带宽消耗速率基本上是平稳的
note: stationary（平稳）：统计性质（均值、方差）不随时间改变；勿与 stationery（文具）混淆。

raw: the Poisson-distribution
translation: 泊松分布
note: 描述固定区间内独立随机事件发生次数的离散分布，前提是到达率恒定且事件互相独立。

raw: that is tailor-made for this application
translation: 简直是为这一用途量身定制的
note: tailor-made 量身定制的（源自 tailor 裁缝）。

raw: call arrival rate was constant and calls arrived independently
translation: 呼叫到达率恒定且各次呼叫相互独立
note: arrival rate（到达率）恒定与相互独立，正是泊松分布成立的两个前提。

raw: has an incredibly high average call rate
translation: （母亲节）的平均通话量高得惊人
note: 美国母亲节为五月第二个周日，历来是电话网络的年度话务高峰。

raw: the very action of one person trading causes another to take action
translation: 正是一个人交易这个动作本身，引发了另一个人也采取行动
note: the very + 名词表强调“正是…本身”；one person trading 为“名词＋动名词”的复合结构，表某人做某事。

raw: This results in a positive feedback loop
translation: 这就形成了正反馈循环
note: 正反馈：结果反过来放大起因，使波动自我强化，与负反馈的自我抑制相对。

raw: To further elaborate
translation: 进一步展开说
note: elaborate（动词）详述、展开说明，重音在第二音节；elaborate on sth。

raw: for various slices of time from 1 second down to 1 millisecond
translation: 针对从 1 秒到 1 毫秒的各种时间切片
note: slice 本句义“（时间的）一段、切片”；常见义“（面包的）一片”。

raw: What is most interesting about Exhibit 14.11 is that it shows directly and empirically how non-stationary the message rates are.
translation: 图表 14.11 最有意思之处在于，它直接、实证地展示了消息速率有多么不平稳。
note: What 引导主语从句，is that… 引导表语从句，从句内再嵌 how + 形容词 + 主谓的宾语从句；empirically 以实证数据的方式。

raw: you would expect to see 1/10th the number of messages in one row as in the preceding row
translation: 你会预期某一行的消息数只有前一行的十分之一
note: preceding 前面的、上一个的；as in the preceding row 是省略比较结构（as [there are] in the preceding row）。

raw: we see that there are 13 messages at the 99th percentile
translation: 我们看到第 99 百分位上只有 13 条消息
note: 此处 see 引出观测到的实际值，与前文 expect（理论预期值）构成对照。

raw: about five times the expectation
translation: 约为期望值的五倍
note: expectation 本句义（统计）“期望值”；常见义“期待、指望”。

raw: yields surprising results
translation: 得出令人意外的结果
note: yield 本句义（动词）“产生、得出（结果）”；常见义（金融名词）“收益率”。

raw: there are 234,000 observations that occur with 1 percent probability during the day
translation: 一天中有 23.4 万个以 1% 概率出现的观测
note: observation 为统计学中的“观测值、样本点”，此处每一毫秒算一个观测。

raw: This should self-evidently be a massive problem
translation: 这不言而喻应当是个大问题
note: self-evidently 不言自明地（形容词 self-evident）。

raw: There are 2,340 millisecond intervals that comprise the busiest 0.01 percent of observations
translation: 有 2340 个毫秒区间构成了最繁忙的 0.01% 观测
note: comprise 此处义“构成、占（整体的一部分）”；comprise 后不接 of。

raw: Whereas the tails of the distribution of messages per 10 seconds are relatively well behaved, the tails of the distribution of messages per millisecond are incredibly badly behaved.
translation: 按每 10 秒统计的消息分布，其尾部相对“乖巧”；而按每毫秒统计的消息分布，尾部则极其“顽劣”。
note: Whereas 引导对比状语从句（“然而、反之”）；tails of the distribution 指分布尾部即极端值区域；well/badly behaved 是数学用语，指是否具有良好性质。

raw: if you are trying to engineer a system to be responsive at a given time scale
translation: 如果你想把系统设计得在某个时间尺度上反应及时
note: engineer 本句义（动词）“设计、构建（系统）”；responsive 反应迅速的。

raw: Compounding the problem is the fact that there is a seasonality of busy-ness within each day.
translation: 雪上加霜的是，每天日内还存在忙闲的周期性规律。
note: 完全倒装：现在分词短语 Compounding the problem 作表语前置，真正主语是 the fact that…；seasonality 此处指日内固定时段的规律性起伏。

raw: the data feed handler
translation: 数据接收处理程序
note: 负责接收、解析交易所行情消息并转成内部格式的软件模块。

raw: bursts of data that might have been handled individually could become overwhelming
translation: 单独处理尚可应付的数据突发，合起来就可能压垮系统
note: data burst（数据突发）：极短时间内消息量骤增数十倍的现象。

raw: And if this wasn’t enough of challenge already
translation: 仿佛这挑战还不够大似的
note: if this wasn't enough 是口语化的让步插入语，后接“更糟的还在后头”；正规写法为 enough of a challenge。

raw: each server is charged with computing and running the actual trading strategy
translation: 每台服务器都负责计算并运行真正的交易策略
note: be charged with 本句义“被赋予…职责”；常见义“被指控（犯罪）；充电”。

raw: attempting to control for risk factors continuously throughout the day
translation: 试图全天持续控制风险因子
note: control for 是统计与建模用语“控制（某变量的影响）”，与 control（掌控）用法不同。

raw: an alpha model with an intraday time horizon
translation: 一个时间跨度在日内的阿尔法模型
note: time horizon（时间跨度）指预测或持仓的时间长度；intraday 日内、当天了结。

raw: index arbitrage is a widely-known HFT strategy
translation: 指数套利是广为人知的高频策略
note: 指数套利：在指数（或其 ETF）与其成分股组合之间捕捉两者定价的偏差。

raw: trading the value of the SPY ETF against the values of the 500 stocks that comprise it
translation: 用 SPY ETF 的价值对做构成它的那 500 只股票的价值
note: trade A against B 指一边做多、一边做空的对冲式交易。

raw: a “bottom-up” estimate of the value of the S&P index
translation: 自下而上估算标普指数的价值
note: 由成分股价格与权重逐一加总，倒推出指数的理论价值。

raw: after accounting for expense ratios
translation: 在计入费用率之后
note: expense ratio（费用率）：基金或 ETF 每年从资产中扣除的管理运营费用比例。

raw: If, however, you find that the actual value of the SPY ETF, after accounting for expense ratios and other similar structural differences between the ETF and a basket of stocks, is trading at a different value, then theoretically free money is to be had by virtue of buying whichever side is under-valued and selling short whichever side is over-valued.
translation: 然而，如果你发现 SPY ETF 的实际价格在计入费用率以及 ETF 与一篮子股票之间其他类似结构性差异之后，处在另一个价位，那么理论上就有白捡的钱：买入被低估的一边、卖空被高估的一边即可。
note: If 从句主干是 you find that … is trading at a different value，中间被 after accounting for… 的长插入语隔开；free money is to be had 用 be to be done 表“可以到手”；whichever side 引导名词性从句作宾语。

raw: As a sidebar
translation: 顺带一提
note: sidebar 本句义“（正文之外的）补充说明、题外话”；常见义“（报刊版面的）边栏”。

raw: comparing the SPY ETF to the basket of stocks that comprise it is not trivial
translation: 把 SPY ETF 与构成它的一篮子股票作比较并不简单
note: trivial 本句义“轻而易举、不费事的”；常见义“琐碎无关紧要的”。

raw: what’s known as a regulatory risk check
translation: 所谓的监管风险校验
note: 下单前由券商系统检查订单是否超出客户资金能力、是否明显错误、是否合规。

raw: under the Market Access Rule
translation: 《市场准入规则》之下
note: 美国 SEC 的 15c3-5 规则，要求提供市场接入的券商对客户订单实施风险控制。

raw: within the means of the trader
translation: 在该交易者的财力范围之内
note: within one's means 量力而行、不超出自身财力。

raw: compliant with regulatory requirements
translation: 符合监管要求的
note: compliant 顺从的、合规的；名词 compliance 合规。

raw: They also mandate that the risk-checking software should be in the full and exclusive control of the broker-dealer
translation: 他们还强制规定，风控软件必须完全且排他地处于经纪自营商的掌控之下
note: mandate 本句义（动词）“强制规定”；常见义（名词）“授权、委托范围”。

raw: Does the trader’s buying power allow for the order(s) in question
translation: 该交易者的可用买入额度是否足以支持所涉订单
note: buying power 购买力、可用下单额度；in question 指“正在讨论的、所涉的”。

raw: an excessive number of open orders
translation: 数量过多的未成交挂单
note: open order 已报出但尚未成交、也未撤销的订单。

raw: These firms engaged in what is called “naked access.”
translation: 这些公司做的是所谓的“裸接入”。
note: 裸接入：客户绕过券商风控系统直连交易所下单，速度最快但风险最终由券商承担，现已被禁。

raw: This meant that customers of the broker-dealer were allowed direct access to the market if the broker was ultimately comfortable enough (after performing many checks of their own) with the client’s risk-checking technology.
translation: 这意味着：只要券商在自行做了许多检查之后，最终对客户自己的风控技术足够放心，券商的客户就被允许直连市场下单。
note: 主句后接 that 宾语从句，从句内再套 if 条件从句；be comfortable with 对…感到放心，被括号插入语拉开了较远距离。

raw: This added “hop” (in network engineering terms)
translation: 这多出来的一“跳”（网络工程术语）
note: hop 本句义“数据包经过一个中间节点的一跳”；常见义“单脚跳”。

raw: the broker’s risk-checking software is generally going to be inferior to that designed by a speed-sensitive trader
translation: 券商的风控软件通常不如对速度敏感的交易者自己设计的那套
note: that 代替前面的 software 以避免重复，后接过去分词短语作定语。

raw: cares a lot more about issues like scalability than being hyper-fast
translation: 更在意可扩展性之类的问题，而不是极致的速度
note: scalability（可扩展性）：系统在负载增长时仍能通过增加资源维持性能的能力。

raw: the “tick-to-trade” total latency
translation: “行情到下单”的总延迟
note: 从收到一条行情消息到把订单发出至交易所为止的全链路耗时，是高频系统的核心指标。

raw: some HFT firms opted to send their trades directly to the exchange
translation: 一些高频公司选择把订单直接发往交易所
note: opt to do 选择做某事；接名词时用 opt for。

raw: after utilizing their own in-house risk checks
translation: 在使用自家内部风控校验之后
note: in-house 自建的、公司内部的，与外购、外包相对。

raw: some brokers made a business of providing naked access to HFTs
translation: 有些券商把给高频公司提供裸接入做成了一门生意
note: make a business of doing 以做某事为业。

raw: build out their own broker-dealer units
translation: 自行搭建起属于自己的经纪自营商实体
note: build out 从头建成、扩建出（一整套设施或部门）。

raw: there is clearly a double standard when it comes to HFT
translation: 一谈到高频交易就明显存在双重标准
note: double standard 双重标准；when it comes to 一谈到…时，to 后接名词或动名词。

raw: People seem to be really angry that HFTs, having solved the incredibly difficult problems enumerated above, have achieved a (completely legal, ethical, and fair) competitive advantage over other traders.
translation: 人们似乎真的很生气：高频交易商在解决了上文列举的那些极其困难的问题之后，取得了（完全合法、合乎道德且公平的）相对其他交易者的竞争优势。
note: angry that… 后接表原因的从句；主语 HFTs 与谓语 have achieved 之间插入 having solved… 完成式分词短语，表动作先于主句；enumerated 列举的。

raw: like any other enterprise in a reasonably free-enterprise system
translation: 与一个大体自由竞争的体系里的任何其他行当没什么两样
note: enterprise 本句义“事业、行当”；free enterprise 则为经济学名词“自由企业制度”。

raw: Countless HFTs have invested enormous sums of time and money into infrastructure, only to find that they lack the ability simply to generate acceptable returns.
translation: 无数高频公司在基础设施上砸下巨量的时间和金钱，结果却发现自己根本没本事做出说得过去的回报。
note: only to do 表出乎意料的结果（“结果却…”），与表目的的不定式不同；lack the ability to do 缺乏做某事的能力。

raw: A typical “build versus buy”
translation: 典型的“自建还是外购”
note: build versus buy：企业决定关键系统是自研还是采购商用方案的经典权衡。

raw: “HFT-in-a-box” solutions
translation: “开箱即用的高频交易”整套方案
note: 仿 X-in-a-box 的营销说法，指供应商把全套高频基础设施打包出售。

raw: when trading activity is at its most frenzied level
translation: 在交易活动最狂热的时候
note: frenzied 疯狂的、狂乱的（名词 frenzy 狂热）。

raw: Responsible people engineer for the 99th percentile.
translation: 负责任的人是按第 99 百分位来设计系统的。
note: engineer for 以…为目标来设计、施工；此处指按极端繁忙情形而非平均值来设计容量。

raw: detractors of HFT have pointed to the near-death experience of Knight Capital
translation: 高频交易的贬低者拿骑士资本的濒死经历说事
note: detractor 诋毁者、唱衰者；point to 指出、援引…作为证据。

raw: It was a mistake of their own doing.
translation: 这是他们自己造成的错误。
note: of one's own doing 由自己一手造成的。

raw: had to secure emergency funding to stay afloat
translation: 不得不筹到紧急融资才免于倒闭
note: secure 此处义（动词）“设法取得”；stay afloat 原指船不沉，喻企业维持不倒。

raw: at the expense of a large portion of the value of their business
translation: 代价是公司价值的一大部分
note: at the expense of 以…为代价。

raw: No “mom and pop” investors, no pensioners, no market systems were harmed.
translation: 没有一个“散户小老百姓”、没有一个靠养老金生活的人、也没有任何市场系统受到伤害。
note: mom and pop 美式说法，原指夫妻小店，引申为缺乏专业能力的小投资者；pensioner 领养老金者。

raw: in pursuit of what amounts to a $0.001 per share profit expectation
translation: 为的是追逐说白了每股 0.001 美元的预期利润
note: in pursuit of 追求；what amounts to 相当于、说白了就是。

raw: That they might make $0.001 per share to provide that liquidity is both inconsequential and totally fair.
translation: 他们为提供这份流动性而每股赚 0.001 美元，这既无足轻重又完全公平。
note: That 引导主语从句（谓语是 is），从句较长时开头的 That 容易被误当作指示代词；inconsequential 无足轻重的。

raw: the capital and time expenditures of competing in a hyper-competitive space
translation: 在超高竞争的领域里参与竞争所需的资金与时间支出
note: expenditure 支出、耗费（正式）；前缀 hyper- 表“过度、超”。

raw: courtesy of Tradeworx, Inc. proprietary research
translation: 由 Tradeworx 公司的自有研究提供
note: courtesy of 蒙…提供、承蒙…惠允；proprietary 专有的、自有的。

raw: so some of this is just incumbency
translation: 所以其中一部分只是“先来后到”的既有优势
note: incumbency 在位、既有地位（形容词 incumbent 现任的、既有的）。

raw: it tends to retain that title with a large amount of inertia on its side
translation: 它往往能保住这个地位，而且巨大的惯性站在它这一边
note: inertia 本句义（比喻）“惰性、路径依赖”；常见义（物理）“惯性”。

raw: it is a pain in the neck to change one’s infrastructure
translation: 更换基础设施是件极其麻烦的事
note: a pain in the neck 令人头疼的麻烦事（口语）。

raw: for all intents and purposes
translation: 就一切实际而言；实际上
note: 固定短语，表“实质上等同于”，常用于把两者视作一回事时。

raw: subject to less onerous taxes
translation: 适用的税负没那么重
note: onerous 繁重的、负担沉重的；be subject to 受…约束、适用于。

raw: the migration of retail investors away from actively managed mutual funds into passive ETFs
translation: 散户从主动管理型共同基金转向被动型 ETF 的迁移
note: actively managed（主动管理）靠基金经理选股，passive（被动）只复制指数，后者费率显著更低。

raw: simply doesn’t want to spend a lot of money to put on that bet
translation: 只是不想花大钱来建立这个头寸
note: put on a bet/trade 建仓、下注，与 take off（平仓）相对。

raw: the realities of the amount of real estate needed for the massive data centers
translation: 巨型数据中心所需占地面积的现实情况
note: real estate 本句义“（所需的）场地、地皮”；常见义“房地产（业）”。

raw: If you have a mouse in your hand, you are too late!
translation: 手里还握着鼠标，你就已经太迟了！
note: 期权做市巨头 Blair Hull 的名言；意指人手操作的速度在电子化市场里已完全不够用。

raw: a high-speed (low-latency) trading infrastructure
translation: 高速（低延迟）交易基础设施
note: latency 指从收到行情到订单抵达市场之间的时间延迟；low-latency 是高频交易的核心工程目标。

raw: contractual market making
translation: 契约型做市
note: 做市商与券商签订合同、包揽其客户订单流并保证成交的模式；与下文非契约型做市相对。

raw: fast alpha
translation: 快阿尔法策略
note: 在日内极短周期上用动量、均值回归等价格信号赚取超额收益的高频策略类别。

raw: all of those that pertain to non-HFT quants
translation: 所有适用于非高频量化交易者的（优势类型）
note: pertain to 本句义"适用于、与…有关"；常见义"从属于"。

raw: it bears discussing how these types of edges typically map to various kinds of HFTs
translation: 值得讨论一下这些优势类型通常如何对应到各类高频交易者身上
note: it bears + 动名词 = 值得被…（bear 此处表"经得起、值得"）；map to 对应到。

raw: has the closest analog to a traditional feature of the markets
translation: 在市场的传统建制中最能找到与之对应的东西
note: analog 本句义"对应物、类似物"；常见义"模拟（信号）的"。

raw: The types of edges that a successful HFT might have include all of those that pertain to non-HFT quants, but we should add/emphasize one additional type, bringing the total to four: the investment process, a lack of competition, something structural, and technology.
translation: 一家成功的高频交易机构可能拥有的优势类型，涵盖了适用于非高频量化交易者的全部类型，但我们还应补充并强调一种，使总数达到四种：投资流程、缺乏竞争、某种结构性因素，以及技术。
note: 主干 The types of edges ... include all of those ...；that a successful HFT might have 是修饰 edges 的定语从句；bringing... 为结果状语的现在分词；冒号后是四项同位列举。

raw: either goes unfilled until a later time
translation: 要么一直未能成交、拖到晚些时候
note: go + 形容词表"处于某种状态"（如 go unnoticed）；unfilled 未成交的，fill 在交易语境中指"（订单）成交"。

raw: for the sole reason that customer B wants to sell them
translation: 仅仅因为客户 B 想把它们卖掉
note: for the sole reason that 意为"唯一的理由就是"，强调别无他因。

raw: they provide liquidity to those who have a utility for it
translation: 他们向对流动性有需求的人提供流动性
note: utility 本句义（经济学）"效用、用处"，have a utility for 即"用得上、有需求"；常见义"公用事业"。

raw: at the whims of retail customers
translation: 随散户客户的心血来潮而变
note: whim 一时兴起的念头；at the whim(s) of 受…的任性摆布。

raw: market makers get paid to warehouse the risk in the interim
translation: 做市商靠在此期间暂存风险来赚钱
note: warehouse 本句义为动词"仓储、暂存（头寸/风险）"；常见义为名词"仓库"。in the interim 在此期间。

raw: order flow internalizers
translation: 订单流内部化者
note: internalize 指券商把客户订单不送交易所、由自家或签约做市商内部撮合成交。

raw: the brokerage routes its customers' orders to the market maker to be executed
translation: 券商把客户订单路由给该做市商去成交
note: route 本句为动词"把（订单）转送到某处成交"，是交易系统里的固定说法。

raw: this is aptly known as
translation: 这被恰如其分地称为
note: aptly 贴切地、恰如其分地；apt 恰当的、易于…的。

raw: In the same way, market participants don't necessarily take investment decisions that coincide perfectly, and market makers get paid to warehouse the risk in the interim.
translation: 同理，市场参与者的投资决策未必能完美对上，于是做市商靠在这中间暂存风险来收取报酬。
note: not necessarily 部分否定"未必"；coincide 恰好一致；两个分句用 and 并列，后半句是前半句造成的结果。

raw: But interestingly, neither the customer's order to buy nor the CMM's taking the other side of that trade ever goes into the exchange's limit order book.
translation: 但有意思的是，无论是客户的买单，还是契约型做市商接下这笔交易对手方的动作，都从未进入交易所的限价订单簿。
note: neither A nor B 作主语时谓语随最近的 B（goes 用单数）；the CMM's taking 是动名词复合结构；take the other side of 承接…的对手方。

raw: by virtue of having agreed to this contractual relationship
translation: 凭借已经同意了这一契约关系
note: by virtue of 凭借、由于（较正式），后接名词或动名词。

raw: gains an advantage that supersedes even the fastest traders
translation: 获得一种连最快的交易者都比不过的优势
note: supersede 取代、优先于、盖过；注意拼写是 -sede 而非 -cede。

raw: the CMM is piggybacking on whatever the prevailing best offer was
translation: 契约型做市商是在搭当时最优卖价的便车
note: piggyback on 借力于、搭…的便车，字面"骑在背上"。

raw: it is not at all obvious that the customer is any worse off
translation: 完全看不出客户的处境有变差
note: be worse off 处境更差、更吃亏（反义 better off）；any 在否定句中加强"丝毫"。

raw: We contended in Chapter 14 that trading passively is not necessarily a highly profitable activity
translation: 我们在第14章主张过，被动交易未必是一项高利润的活动
note: contend 本句义"主张、论证"；另一常见义"争夺、与…较量"。

raw: the problem of adverse selection
translation: 逆向选择问题
note: 做市语境中指：愿意与你的挂单成交的对手方，往往是掌握了对你不利信息的一方。

raw: when facing off against retail order flow
translation: 当与散户订单流正面交锋时
note: face off against 与…对阵、正面交锋，源自冰球开球术语。

raw: the aggregate of these orders on a given name
translation: 同一只个股上这些订单的合计
note: name 本句义"（一只）证券、标的"，交易圈行话；aggregate 合计、总量。

raw: there is unlikely to be any significant price impact
translation: 不太可能产生明显的价格冲击
note: price impact（市场冲击）指自己的交易行为本身把价格推向不利方向的程度。

raw: here, a perverse incentive may exist
translation: 这里可能存在一种扭曲的激励
note: perverse incentive 指制度设计反而鼓励当事人做出与初衷相反行为的激励。

raw: lift all 2,000 shares offered at $100.01
translation: 把100.01美元上挂出的全部2000股全数吃掉
note: lift（an offer）主动买入、吃掉卖单；对应 hit（a bid）主动卖出、砸向买单。

raw: This happens in the reverse sequence than in a normal market situation: generally a passive order is resting in the limit order book and an active order comes into the market later and takes the liquidity offered by the passive order.
translation: 这里发生的顺序与正常市场情形正好相反：通常是一笔被动挂单先驻留在限价订单簿中，随后一笔主动订单进场，把被动挂单提供的流动性吃掉。
note: in the reverse sequence than 为作者的口语化比较（规范说法是 from）；冒号后用两个 and 并列的分句说明"正常顺序"；resting 指挂单驻留等待成交。

raw: until the buy order was almost exhausted
translation: 直到这笔买单几乎被消耗殆尽
note: exhaust 本句义"（订单可成交量）被耗尽"；常见义"使人精疲力竭"。

raw: the offered side of the book is likely to replenish
translation: 订单簿的卖方一侧很可能会重新补挂
note: replenish 重新填满、补充；the offered side 指订单簿上挂卖单的那一侧。

raw: If there was no other buying pressure behind that 10,000 share buy order
translation: 如果那笔1万股买单背后并没有其他买盘力量
note: buying pressure 买盘压力，即持续的主动买入需求；behind 本句义"跟在…后面（作为后续支撑）"。

raw: It may incentivize the CMM to act in a way that is adverse to the customer
translation: 它可能诱使契约型做市商采取对客户不利的做法
note: incentivize sb to do 给予某人做某事的动机；名词 incentive。

raw: this is, at the least, an interesting dynamic
translation: 至少可以说，这是一种耐人寻味的互动格局
note: dynamic 本句为名词"（各方相互作用形成的）态势、机制"；常见义为形容词"有活力的"。at the least 至少。

raw: to do the worst possible job of filling the bulk of the customer's order
translation: 把客户订单的绝大部分执行得要多糟有多糟
note: the bulk of 本句义"…的大部分"；bulk 常见义"体积、大块"。do a good/bad job of doing 把某事做得好/差。

raw: at the expense of those traders whose orders were at lower-priced offers initially
translation: 代价由那些起初挂了更低卖价的交易者承担
note: at the expense of 以牺牲…为代价；whose 引导的定语从句修饰 traders。

raw: If there was no other buying pressure behind that 10,000 share buy order, the upward move is likely to be immediately reversed, and the offered side of the book is likely to replenish with lower-priced offers than $100.03.
translation: 如果那笔1万股买单背后没有别的买盘力量，这波上涨很可能立刻反转，订单簿卖方一侧也很可能重新补上比100.03美元更低的卖价。
note: If 条件句后接两个并列主句（is likely to be reversed / is likely to replenish）；replenish with 用…补充；than 比较对象是 $100.03。

raw: So in this case, since the CMM knew that this customer's order was about to push the price up, he delayed selling until the buy order was almost exhausted.
translation: 所以在这种情形下，由于契约型做市商知道这位客户的订单即将把价格推高，他便拖着不卖，直到这笔买单几乎被吃干净。
note: since 引导原因状语从句（此处非"自从"）；be about to do 即将；delay + 动名词（delay selling）为固定搭配。

raw: at an untenably high price
translation: 以高得站不住脚的价格
note: untenable 站不住脚的、难以维持的；副词 untenably 修饰 high。

raw: Knight's brush with bankruptcy unfolded in merely a half-hour
translation: 骑士公司与破产擦肩而过的全过程仅在半小时内上演
note: a brush with 与（危险、麻烦）的一次险些遭遇；unfold（事件）展开、上演。

raw: the Retail Liquidity Program (RLP)
translation: 散户流动性计划（RLP）
note: 纽交所推出的机制，允许在公开盘面给散户订单提供优于最优报价的成交价，以争回被内部化的订单流。

raw: programs such as the RLP are not intended to put CMMs out of business
translation: RLP 这类计划并非意在把契约型做市商挤垮出局
note: put sb out of business 使某人停业倒闭；be intended to 意在、旨在。
